   330	/-- The side-indexed global polynomial-pair measurements handed to Chapter 16.
   331	This is the exact conclusion of `lem:qld-4-7`, paper lines 1267--1274, with
   332	the two heterogeneous point-consistency displays stated separately. -/
   333	structure GlobalPairWitness {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
   334	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (δ : ℝ) where
   335	  /-- The complete global polynomial-pair measurement on each player side. -/
   336	  Smeas : (side : PlayerSide) ->
   337	    Measurement (PolyPair P) (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side)
   338	  /-- Both global polynomial-pair measurements are projective. -/
   339	  projective : ∀ side, Measurement.IsProjective (Smeas side)
   340	  /-- Alice's global evaluations are consistent with Bob's source point
   341	  measurements, for each Pauli basis. -/
   342	  point_consistent_alice : ∀ W : PauliKind,
   343	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m -> PauliScalar P))
   344	      (fun u a => S.place .AA'
   345	        (((Smeas .alice).postprocess (evalAt W u)).effect a))
   346	      (fun u a => S.place .BA''
   347	        ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect a))
   348	      S.psiHat <= δ
   349	  /-- Bob's global evaluations are consistent with Alice's source point
   350	  measurements, for each Pauli basis. -/
   351	  point_consistent_bob : ∀ W : PauliKind,
   352	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m -> PauliScalar P))
   353	      (fun u a => S.place .BB'
   354	        (((Smeas .bob).postprocess (evalAt W u)).effect a))
   355	      (fun u a => S.place .AB''
   356	        ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect a))
   357	      S.psiHat <= δ

     4	/-!
     5	# Sub-line averages of the Z-point overlap
     6	
     7	The overlap of the paired-line measurement with the expanded `Z`-point effect
     8	depends only on the two source lines and the `Z`-point. The separate Z marginal
     9	of the auxiliary `SubLineWitness` law is a mixture of products of restricted
    10	line-point laws, with the fresh X point unused. Summing line answers over the
    11	evaluation fibers at that fresh point identifies the overlap with the
    12	evaluated pair-line overlap, so the Z deficit estimates of
    13	`MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.ZEvalDeficit` apply component by component.
    14	
    15	The `_at` estimates and `zPointOverlapAt` retain arbitrary
    16	opposite placements. The original overlap definitions and first-player
    17	statements are unchanged. Only the separate Z marginal mixture law is used.
    18	Transport of the auxiliary extended-line law to the source carrier remains
    19	open; see `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`, section
    20	"Scalar estimates on the auxiliary subline law".
    21	
    22	## References
    23	
    24	The statements support the auxiliary `lem:claim-17-3-direct-real`, near
    25	the source `lem:claim-17-3` in
    26	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex`, paper
    27	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1204-1239`; the
    28	mixture is Property~2 of `lem:qld-sublines`.
    29	-/

    39	/-! ## Regrouping the line answers by their evaluations -/
    40	
    41	/-- Summing a paired-line answer against a family of point effects that
    42	depends on the answer only through its two evaluations is summing the
    43	evaluation classes of the paired-line measurement against that family.  This
    44	is the fiber regrouping of the proofs of `lem:claim-17-1`, `lem:claim-17-2`,
    45	and `lem:claim-17-3` in the blueprint. -/
    46	theorem regroup_line_answer_sum_at {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε δQ δP : ℝ}
    47	    {S : ProjectiveSetting P ε} {points : CombinedPointsWitness S δQ}
    48	    (lines : CombinedLinesWitness S points δP)
    49	    (first second : Placement)
    50	    (lineX lineZ : LineDesc P.toLdParams) (x z : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
    51	    (G : Option (PauliScalar P) → Option (PauliScalar P) →
    52	      Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace second.side)) :
    53	    (∑ o : Option (PauliScalar P) × Option (PauliScalar P),
    54	        stateQForm S.psiHat
    55	          ((S.placedMeasurement first
    56	            ((lines.T first.side lineX lineZ).postprocess (fun fs =>
    57	              (evalOpt lineX x fs.1, evalOpt lineZ z fs.2)))).effect o *
    58	            S.place second (G o.1 o.2))) =
    59	      ∑ fX, ∑ fZ, stateQForm S.psiHat
    60	        (S.place first ((lines.T first.side lineX lineZ).effect (fX, fZ)) *
    61	          S.place second (G (evalOpt lineX x fX) (evalOpt lineZ z fZ))) := by
    62	  classical
    63	  have hsum : ∀ (s : Finset (DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d) ×
    64	        DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d)))
    65	      (M : DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d) ×
    66	        DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d) →
    67	        Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace first.side))
    68	      (N : Op (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)),
    69	      stateQForm S.psiHat (S.place first (∑ fs ∈ s, M fs) * N) =
    70	        ∑ fs ∈ s, stateQForm S.psiHat (S.place first (M fs) * N) := by
    71	    intro s M N
    72	    rw [S.place_finsetSum]
    73	    simp [stateQForm, applyOperatorToState, Finset.sum_mul]
    74	  calc
    75	    (∑ o : Option (PauliScalar P) × Option (PauliScalar P),
    76	          stateQForm S.psiHat
    77	            ((S.placedMeasurement first
    78	              ((lines.T first.side lineX lineZ).postprocess (fun fs =>
    79	                (evalOpt lineX x fs.1, evalOpt lineZ z fs.2)))).effect o *
    80	              S.place second (G o.1 o.2))) =
    81	        ∑ o : Option (PauliScalar P) × Option (PauliScalar P),
    82	          ∑ fs ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun fs =>
    83	              (evalOpt lineX x fs.1, evalOpt lineZ z fs.2) = o),
    84	            stateQForm S.psiHat
    85	              (S.place first ((lines.T first.side lineX lineZ).effect fs) *
    86	                S.place second (G o.1 o.2)) := by
    87	      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun o _ => ?_
    88	      rw [ProjectiveSetting.placedMeasurement_effect,
    89	        MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect]
    90	      exact hsum _ _ _
    91	    _ = ∑ o : Option (PauliScalar P) × Option (PauliScalar P),
    92	          ∑ fs ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun fs =>
    93	              (evalOpt lineX x fs.1, evalOpt lineZ z fs.2) = o),
    94	            stateQForm S.psiHat
    95	              (S.place first ((lines.T first.side lineX lineZ).effect fs) *
    96	                S.place second
    97	                  (G (evalOpt lineX x fs.1) (evalOpt lineZ z fs.2))) := by
    98	      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun o _ =>
    99	        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun fs hfs => ?_
   100	      rw [← (Finset.mem_filter.mp hfs).2]
   101	    _ = ∑ fs : DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d) ×
   102	          DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d),
   103	          stateQForm S.psiHat
   104	            (S.place first ((lines.T first.side lineX lineZ).effect fs) *
   105	              S.place second
   106	                (G (evalOpt lineX x fs.1) (evalOpt lineZ z fs.2))) :=
   107	      Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (fun fs _ => Finset.mem_univ _) _
   108	    _ = ∑ fX, ∑ fZ, stateQForm S.psiHat
   109	          (S.place first ((lines.T first.side lineX lineZ).effect (fX, fZ)) *
   110	            S.place second (G (evalOpt lineX x fX) (evalOpt lineZ z fZ))) :=
   111	      Fintype.sum_prod_type (f := fun fs => stateQForm S.psiHat
   112	        (S.place first ((lines.T first.side lineX lineZ).effect fs) *
   113	          S.place second (G (evalOpt lineX x fs.1) (evalOpt lineZ z fs.2))))
   114	
   115	theorem regroup_line_answer_sum {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε δQ δP : ℝ}
   116	    {S : ProjectiveSetting P ε} {points : CombinedPointsWitness S δQ}
   117	    (lines : CombinedLinesWitness S points δP)
   118	    (lineX lineZ : LineDesc P.toLdParams) (x z : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
   119	    (G : Option (PauliScalar P) → Option (PauliScalar P) →
   120	      Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace Placement.BA''.side)) :
   121	    (∑ o : Option (PauliScalar P) × Option (PauliScalar P),
   122	        stateQForm S.psiHat
   123	          ((S.placedMeasurement .AA'
   124	            ((lines.T .alice lineX lineZ).postprocess (fun fs =>
   125	              (evalOpt lineX x fs.1, evalOpt lineZ z fs.2)))).effect o *
   126	            S.place .BA'' (G o.1 o.2))) =
   127	      ∑ fX, ∑ fZ, stateQForm S.psiHat
   128	        (S.place .AA' ((lines.T .alice lineX lineZ).effect (fX, fZ)) *
   129	          S.place .BA'' (G (evalOpt lineX x fX) (evalOpt lineZ z fZ))) := by
   130	  exact regroup_line_answer_sum_at lines .AA' .BA'' lineX lineZ x z G

   132	/-- The sub-line average of a function of the two source lines and the
   133	`Z`-point of the sampled extended point is a mixture of averages over products
   134	of two restricted line-point laws, the `Z`-point being the point of the second
   135	factor.  This is the use of Property~2 of `lem:qld-sublines` in the proof of
   136	`lem:claim-17-3`, blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex`,
   137	paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1204-1239`. -/
   138	theorem SubLineWitness.exists_avgOver_Z_eq_mixture (P : AdmissibleParams)
   139	    (sublines : SubLineWitness P)
   140	    (F : (LineDesc P.toLdParams × LineDesc P.toLdParams) ×
   141	      (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) → ℝ) :
   142	    ∃ components : Distribution (SubLineComponent P), components.IsProbability ∧
   143	      avgOver sublines.D (fun sample =>
   144	          avgOver (uniformDistribution (DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd))
   145	            (fun t => F (sample.2, projZ (directPointToPauli P
   146	              (sample.1.base + t • sample.1.direction))))) =
   147	        avgOver components (fun c =>
   148	          avgOver (Distribution.prod (restrictedLinePointDist P c.1 c.2.1)
   149	              (restrictedLinePointDist P c.1 c.2.2))
   150	            (fun w => F ((w.1.1, w.2.1), w.2.2))) := by
   151	  obtain ⟨components, hcomp, -, hZ⟩ := sublines.source_mixture
   152	  refine ⟨components, hcomp, ?_⟩
   153	  have h1 : avgOver sublines.D (fun sample =>
   154	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd))
   155	        (fun t => F (sample.2, projZ (directPointToPauli P
   156	          (sample.1.base + t • sample.1.direction))))) =
   157	      avgOver ((subLinePointDist P sublines.D).map subLineZProjection) F := by
   158	    rw [Distribution.avgOver_map, subLinePointDist, Distribution.avgOver_map,
   159	      avgOver_prod]
   160	    rfl
   161	  rw [h1, hZ, avgOver_bind]
   162	  refine avgOver_congr _ _ _ fun c => ?_
   163	  rw [subLineZComponentDist, Distribution.avgOver_map, Distribution.prod_map_left,
   164	    Distribution.avgOver_map]

   170	variable {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε δQ δP : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P ε}

   173	/-- The overlap of the paired-line measurement at two source lines with the
   174	expanded `Z`-point effect at a point, summed over the line answers.  This is
   175	the integrand of the left-hand side of `lem:claim-17-3`, as a function of the
   176	two source lines and the `Z`-point alone. -/
   177	def zPointOverlapAt (lines : CombinedLinesWitness S points δP)
   178	    (first second : Placement)
   179	    (w : (LineDesc P.toLdParams × LineDesc P.toLdParams) ×
   180	      (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) : ℝ :=
   181	  ∑ fX, ∑ fZ, stateQForm S.psiHat
   182	    (S.place first ((lines.T first.side w.1.1 w.1.2).effect (fX, fZ)) *
   183	      S.place second ((S.pointMeasExpOption second.side .Z w.2).effect (evalOpt w.1.2 w.2 fZ)))
   184	
   185	/-- The original first-player specialization of the placed overlap. -/
   186	def zPointOverlap (lines : CombinedLinesWitness S points δP)
   187	    (w : (LineDesc P.toLdParams × LineDesc P.toLdParams) ×
   188	      (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) : ℝ :=
   189	  ∑ fX, ∑ fZ, stateQForm S.psiHat
   190	    (S.place .AA' ((lines.T .alice w.1.1 w.1.2).effect (fX, fZ)) *
   191	      S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExpOption .bob .Z w.2).effect (evalOpt w.1.2 w.2 fZ)))

   194	evaluated pair-line measurement with the completed `Z`-point measurement; the
   195	`X`-point of the first pair only labels the evaluation classes. -/

   197	    (first second : Placement)
   198	    (w : LinePointPairSample P) :
   199	    zPointOverlapAt lines first second ((w.1.1, w.2.1), w.2.2) =
   200	      ∑ o : Option (PauliScalar P) × Option (PauliScalar P),
   201	        stateQForm S.psiHat
   202	          (S.place first
   203	            (((lines.T first.side w.1.1 w.2.1).postprocess fun fs =>
   204	              (evalOpt w.1.1 w.1.2 fs.1, evalOpt w.2.1 w.2.2 fs.2)).effect o) *
   205	            S.place second ((S.pointMeasExpOption second.side .Z w.2.2).effect o.2)) :=
   206	  (regroup_line_answer_sum_at lines first second w.1.1 w.2.1 w.1.2 w.2.2
   207	    (fun _ o2 => (S.pointMeasExpOption second.side .Z w.2.2).effect o2)).symm
   208	
   209	/-- The original first-player specialization of the placed estimate. -/
   210	theorem zPointOverlap_eq (lines : CombinedLinesWitness S points δP)
   211	    (w : LinePointPairSample P) :
   212	    zPointOverlap lines ((w.1.1, w.2.1), w.2.2) =
   213	      ∑ o : Option (PauliScalar P) × Option (PauliScalar P),
   214	        stateQForm S.psiHat
   215	          (S.place .AA'
   216	            (((lines.T .alice w.1.1 w.2.1).postprocess fun fs =>
   217	              (evalOpt w.1.1 w.1.2 fs.1, evalOpt w.2.1 w.2.2 fs.2)).effect o) *
   218	            S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExpOption .bob .Z w.2.2).effect o.2)) := by
   219	  exact zPointOverlap_eq_at lines .AA' .BA'' w

   225	      (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) :

   229	      ((lines.T first.side w.1.1 w.1.2).pos (fX, fZ))
   230	      ((S.pointMeasExpOption second.side .Z w.2).pos (evalOpt w.1.2 w.2 fZ)))

   235	      (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) :
   236	    0 ≤ zPointOverlap lines w := by
   237	  exact zPointOverlap_nonneg_at lines .AA' .BA'' trivial w

   239	/-- The sub-line average of the `Z`-point overlap is at most one. -/
   240	theorem SubLineWitness.avgOver_zPointOverlap_le_one_at (sublines : SubLineWitness P)
   241	    (lines : CombinedLinesWitness S points δP)
   242	    (first second : Placement) (hopposite : first.IsOpposite second) :

   244	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd))

   246	          (sample.1.base + t • sample.1.direction))))) ≤ 1 := by
   247	  obtain ⟨components, hcomp, hmix⟩ :=
   248	    SubLineWitness.exists_avgOver_Z_eq_mixture P sublines (zPointOverlapAt lines first second)
   249	  rw [hmix]

   252	          (restrictedLinePointDist P c.1 c.2.2))

   254	    intro c

   256	      (Distribution.prod (restrictedLinePointDist P c.1 c.2.1)

   259	        ((lines.T first.side w.1.1 w.2.1).postprocess fun fs =>

   263	        S.place second ((S.pointMeasExpOption second.side .Z w.2.2).effect o.2))

   284	          (sample.1.base + t • sample.1.direction))))) ≤ 1 := by
   285	  exact SubLineWitness.avgOver_zPointOverlap_le_one_at sublines lines .AA' .BA'' trivial

   287	/-- The deficit of the sub-line average of the `Z`-point overlap is bounded by

   290	the source `lem:claim-17-3`, blueprint
   291	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex`, paper
   292	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1204-1239`. -/
   293	theorem SubLineWitness.one_sub_avgOver_zPointOverlap_le_at
   294	    (sublines : SubLineWitness P) (lines : CombinedLinesWitness S points δP)
   295	    (first second : Placement) (hopposite : first.IsOpposite second) :
   296	    1 - avgOver sublines.D (fun sample =>
   297	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd))
   298	        (fun t => zPointOverlapAt lines first second (sample.2, projZ (directPointToPauli P
   299	          (sample.1.base + t • sample.1.direction))))) ≤
   300	      2 * Real.sqrt (4 * (P.m : ℝ) ^ 2 * δP) + 2 * Real.sqrt (4 * δQ) := by
   301	  obtain ⟨components, hcomp, hmix⟩ :=
   302	    SubLineWitness.exists_avgOver_Z_eq_mixture P sublines (zPointOverlapAt lines first second)
   303	  rw [hmix]
   304	  have hsplit : avgOver components (fun c => 1 -
   305	      avgOver (Distribution.prod (restrictedLinePointDist P c.1 c.2.1)
   306	        (restrictedLinePointDist P c.1 c.2.2))
   307	        (fun w => zPointOverlapAt lines first second ((w.1.1, w.2.1), w.2.2))) =
   308	      1 - avgOver components (fun c =>
   309	        avgOver (Distribution.prod (restrictedLinePointDist P c.1 c.2.1)
   310	          (restrictedLinePointDist P c.1 c.2.2))
   311	          (fun w => zPointOverlapAt lines first second ((w.1.1, w.2.1), w.2.2))) := by
   312	    rw [avgOver_sub, avgOver_const_of_isProbability components hcomp]
   313	  rw [← hsplit]
   314	  calc
   315	    _ ≤ avgOver components (fun _ =>
   316	        2 * Real.sqrt (4 * (P.m : ℝ) ^ 2 * δP) + 2 * Real.sqrt (4 * δQ)) := by
   317	      refine avgOver_mono _ _ _ fun c => ?_
   318	      rw [avgOver_congr _ _ _ fun w => zPointOverlap_eq_at lines first second w]
   319	      exact lines.one_sub_Z_overlap_restricted_le_at first second hopposite c.1 c.1 c.2.1 c.2.2
   320	    _ = _ := avgOver_const_of_isProbability components hcomp _

     6	/-!
     7	# Z-point deficits of the evaluated pair-line measurement
     8	
     9	The proof of `lem:claim-17-3` bounds, after its Cauchy--Schwarz step, the
    10	deficit of the overlap between the evaluated pair-line measurement and the
    11	expanded `Z`-point measurement at the `Z`-point of the sample.
    12	This module derives that deficit from the
    13	consistency of the evaluated pair-line measurement with the completed joint
    14	point measurement and from the closeness of the joint point measurement to the
    15	ordered point products. The derivation inserts the joint point measurement
    16	on the point side, replaces it by the ordered product whose trailing factor is
    17	the retained point effect, and sums the other factor, at the cost of three
    18	square roots. The deficit is first bounded over an arbitrary probability
    19	law on pairs of line-point pairs and then over a product of two restricted
    20	line-point laws, whose point marginal is the uniform pair.
    21	The `_at` variants retain arbitrary opposite placements, including Bob at
    22	`BBprime` and Alice at `ABdoubleprime`. The original statements are unchanged
    23	specializations; register commutation does not assume symmetry of the state.
    24	
    25	## References
    26	
    27	The Z deficit is the quantity bounded in the proof of `lem:claim-17-3`
    28	in `blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex`, paper
    29	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1204-1239`; the
    30	consistency input is `lem:qld-xz-lines` and the ordered products are those of
    31	`lem:qld-4-10`.
    32	-/

    45	/-- A sum over completed outcome pairs of a function vanishing on both `none`
    46	classes is the sum over the uncompleted pairs. -/
    47	theorem sum_option_prod_eq_of_none {β γ : Type*} [Fintype β] [Fintype γ]
    48	    (F : Option β × Option γ → ℝ) (h1 : ∀ o2, F (none, o2) = 0)
    49	    (h2 : ∀ o1, F (o1, none) = 0) :
    50	    (∑ o, F o) = ∑ bc : β × γ, F (some bc.1, some bc.2) := by
    51	  calc (∑ o : Option β × Option γ, F o)
    52	      = ∑ o1 : Option β, ∑ o2 : Option γ, F (o1, o2) := Fintype.sum_prod_type (f := F)
    53	    _ = (∑ o2 : Option γ, F (none, o2)) +
    54	          ∑ b : β, ∑ o2 : Option γ, F (some b, o2) := Fintype.sum_option _
    55	    _ = ∑ b : β, ∑ o2 : Option γ, F (some b, o2) := by
    56	        rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero fun o2 _ => h1 o2, zero_add]
    57	    _ = ∑ b : β, (F (some b, none) + ∑ c : γ, F (some b, some c)) :=
    58	        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => Fintype.sum_option _
    59	    _ = ∑ b : β, ∑ c : γ, F (some b, some c) := by
    60	        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
    61	        rw [h2 (some b), zero_add]
    62	    _ = ∑ bc : β × γ, F (some bc.1, some bc.2) :=
    63	        (Fintype.sum_prod_type (f := fun bc : β × γ => F (some bc.1, some bc.2))).symm
    64	
    65	/-- The completed joint measurement has the joint effect on a pair of
    66	evaluations. -/
    67	theorem completedPair_effect_some {β γ d : Type*} [Fintype β] [Fintype γ]
    68	    [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ] [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
    69	    (Q : Measurement (β × γ) d) (bc : β × γ) :
    70	    (Q.postprocess fun ab => (some ab.1, some ab.2)).effect (some bc.1, some bc.2) =
    71	      Q.effect bc := by
    72	  rw [MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect,
    73	    show (Finset.univ.filter fun cd : β × γ =>
    74	        (some cd.1, some cd.2) = (some bc.1, some bc.2)) = {bc} by
    75	      ext cd; simp [Prod.ext_iff, eq_comm]]
    76	  simp
    77	
    78	/-- The completed joint measurement vanishes on outcomes outside the image of
    79	the completion. -/
    80	theorem completedPair_effect_eq_zero {β γ d : Type*} [Fintype β] [Fintype γ]
    81	    [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ] [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
    82	    (Q : Measurement (β × γ) d) (o : Option β × Option γ)
    83	    (ho : ∀ bc : β × γ, (some bc.1, some bc.2) ≠ o) :
    84	    (Q.postprocess fun ab => (some ab.1, some ab.2)).effect o = 0 := by
    85	  rw [MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect]
    86	  exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun bc hbc =>
    87	    absurd (Finset.mem_filter.mp hbc).2 (ho bc)
    88	
    89	/-- The completion of a projective joint measurement is projective. -/
    90	theorem completedPair_isProjective {β γ d : Type*} [Fintype β] [Fintype γ]
    91	    [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ] [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
    92	    (Q : Measurement (β × γ) d) (hQ : Measurement.IsProjective Q) :
    93	    Measurement.IsProjective (Q.postprocess fun ab => (some ab.1, some ab.2)) := by
    94	  intro o
    95	  by_cases h : ∃ bc : β × γ, (some bc.1, some bc.2) = o
    96	  · obtain ⟨bc, rfl⟩ := h
    97	    rw [completedPair_effect_some]
    98	    exact hQ bc
    99	  · push Not at h
   100	    rw [completedPair_effect_eq_zero Q o h]
   101	    exact IsStarProjection.zero _

   107	/-- A placed projection is a projection. -/
   108	theorem place_isProj (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p : Placement)
   109	    {E : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)} (hE : IsProj E) :
   110	    IsProj (S.place p E) := by
   111	  refine isStarProjection_iff'.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩
   112	  · change S.place p E * S.place p E = S.place p E
   113	    rw [← place_mul, hE.isIdempotentElem.eq]
   114	  · rw [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, ← place_conjTranspose,
   115	      hE.isSelfAdjoint.isHermitian.eq]

   117	/-- Every effect of the completed expanded point measurement is a projection,
   118	the `none` effect being zero. -/
   119	theorem pointMeasExpOption_isProj (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
   120	    (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
   121	    (o : Option (PauliScalar P)) :
   122	    IsProj ((S.pointMeasExpOption side W u).effect o) := by
   123	  cases o with
   124	  | none =>
   125	    rw [S.pointMeasExpOption_effect_none]
   126	    exact IsStarProjection.zero _
   127	  | some a =>
   128	    rw [S.pointMeasExpOption_effect_some]
   129	    exact S.pointMeasExp_isProjective side W u a

   131	/-- The completed joint point measurement and a completed point product differ
   132	only on outcome pairs with two evaluations, so their placed state-dependent
   133	squared distance is the one of the joint point measurement and the point
   134	product.  Blueprint `ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:2651-2698`. -/
   135	theorem sum_norm_place_completedPair_sub_sq (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
   136	    (p : Placement)
   137	    (Q : Measurement (PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P) (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side))
   138	    (Gc : Option (PauliScalar P) × Option (PauliScalar P) →
   139	      Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side))
   140	    (G : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P → Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side))
   141	    (hsome : ∀ ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P, Gc (some ab.1, some ab.2) = G ab)
   142	    (hnone1 : ∀ o2, Gc (none, o2) = 0) (hnone2 : ∀ o1, Gc (o1, none) = 0) :
   143	    (∑ o : Option (PauliScalar P) × Option (PauliScalar P),
   144	        ‖applyOperatorToState
   145	          (S.place p ((Q.postprocess fun ab => (some ab.1, some ab.2)).effect o) -
   146	            S.place p (Gc o)) S.psiHat‖ ^ 2) =
   147	      ∑ ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P,
   148	        ‖applyOperatorToState (S.place p (Q.effect ab) - S.place p (G ab))
   149	          S.psiHat‖ ^ 2 := by
   150	  refine Eq.trans (sum_option_prod_eq_of_none _ ?_ ?_) ?_
   151	  · intro o2
   152	    rw [completedPair_effect_eq_zero Q (none, o2) (fun ab => by simp), hnone1,
   153	      place_zero, sub_self]
   154	    simp [applyOperatorToState]
   155	  · intro o1
   156	    rw [completedPair_effect_eq_zero Q (o1, none) (fun ab => by simp), hnone2,
   157	      place_zero, sub_self]
   158	    simp [applyOperatorToState]
   159	  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ab _ => ?_
   160	    rw [completedPair_effect_some, hsome]

   162	/-- The completed `Z`-then-`X` point product vanishes on both `none` classes
   163	and restricts to the ordered product on evaluated pairs. -/
   164	theorem completedPair_norm_sq_sum_ZX (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) {δ : ℝ}
   165	    (points : CombinedPointsWitness S δ) (p : Placement)
   166	    (x z : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
   167	    (∑ o : Option (PauliScalar P) × Option (PauliScalar P),
   168	        ‖applyOperatorToState
   169	          (S.place p (((points.Q p.side x z).postprocess (fun ab =>
   170	              (some ab.1, some ab.2))).effect o) -
   171	            S.place p
   172	              ((S.pointMeasExpOption p.side .Z z).effect o.2 *
   173	                (S.pointMeasExpOption p.side .X x).effect o.1))
   174	          S.psiHat‖ ^ 2) =
   175	      ∑ ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P,
   176	        ‖applyOperatorToState
   177	          (S.place p ((points.Q p.side x z).effect ab) -
   178	            S.place p
   179	              ((S.pointMeasExp p.side .Z z).effect ab.2 *
   180	                (S.pointMeasExp p.side .X x).effect ab.1))
   181	          S.psiHat‖ ^ 2 := by
   182	  refine S.sum_norm_place_completedPair_sub_sq p (points.Q p.side x z) _ _ ?_ ?_ ?_
   183	  · intro ab
   184	    rw [S.pointMeasExpOption_effect_some, S.pointMeasExpOption_effect_some]
   185	  · intro o2
   186	    rw [S.pointMeasExpOption_effect_none, mul_zero]
   187	  · intro o1
   188	    rw [S.pointMeasExpOption_effect_none, zero_mul]

   193	/-! ## The abstract one-point deficit -/
   194	
   195	/-- Let `A` be a complete measurement, `Q` a projective measurement, `R` a
   196	family of projections and `W` a family of operators, all indexed by the same
   197	outcomes, with `Q`, `R` and `W` commuting with the effects of `A` and with
   198	`W R = W`.  If `A` and `Q` are consistent with defect at most `η` and `Q` is
   199	within squared distance `ζ` of `Wᴴ`, then the deficit of the overlap of `A`
   200	with `R` is at most `2 √η + 2 √ζ`.  The proof inserts `Q` before `R`, replaces
   201	`Q R` by `W R = W`, and compares `W` with `Q`; each of the three steps is a
   202	Cauchy--Schwarz estimate weighted by `A`.  This is the common estimate behind
   203	the deficits in the proofs of `lem:claim-17-2` and `lem:claim-17-3`, paper
   204	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1168-1239`. -/
   205	theorem one_sub_overlap_le_of_consistencyDefect {X α ι : Type*}
   206	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   207	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   208	    (μ : Distribution X) (A Q : X → Measurement α ι) (R W : X → α → Op ι)
   209	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (hμ : μ.IsProbability) (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1)
   210	    (hQ : ∀ x, Measurement.IsProjective (Q x)) (hR : ∀ x a, IsProj (R x a))
   211	    (hAQ : ∀ x a, Commute ((A x).effect a) ((Q x).effect a))
   212	    (hAR : ∀ x a, Commute ((A x).effect a) (R x a))
   213	    (hAW : ∀ x a, Commute ((A x).effect a) (W x a))
   214	    (hWR : ∀ x a, W x a * R x a = W x a)
   215	    (hnonneg : ∀ x a, 0 ≤ stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * (Q x).effect a))
   216	    (η ζ : ℝ)
   217	    (hcons : consistencyDefect μ (fun x a => (A x).effect a)
   218	      (fun x a => (Q x).effect a) ψ ≤ η)
   219	    (hdist : opFamilyDistSq μ (fun x a => (Q x).effect a)
   220	      (fun x a => (W x a)ᴴ) ψ ≤ ζ) :
   221	    1 - avgOver μ (fun x => ∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * R x a)) ≤
   222	      2 * Real.sqrt η + 2 * Real.sqrt ζ := by
   223	  set ovQ := avgOver μ (fun x =>
   224	    ∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * (Q x).effect a)) with hovQ
   225	  have h1 : 1 - ovQ ≤ η := by
   226	    rw [← consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_overlap μ A Q ψ hμ hψ]
   227	    exact hcons
   228	  have hovQ_nonneg : 0 ≤ ovQ :=
   229	    avgOver_nonneg μ _ fun x => Finset.sum_nonneg fun a _ => hnonneg x a
   230	  have hovQ_le : ovQ ≤ 1 :=
   231	    avgOver_sum_stateQForm_mul_le_one μ A (fun x a => (Q x).effect a) ψ hμ hψ
   232	      (fun x a => hQ x a) hAQ
   233	  have h1' : 1 - ovQ ≤ Real.sqrt η := by
   234	    have h0 : 0 ≤ 1 - ovQ := by linarith
   235	    calc 1 - ovQ = Real.sqrt ((1 - ovQ) ^ 2) := (Real.sqrt_sq h0).symm
   236	      _ ≤ Real.sqrt η := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by nlinarith)
   237	  -- comparing `Q` with `W` under the weight `A`
   238	  have hWconj : ∀ x a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * W x a) =
   239	      stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * (W x a)ᴴ) := by
   240	    intro x a
   241	    rw [← stateQForm_conjTranspose ψ ((A x).effect a * W x a),
   242	      Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, measurement_effect_hermitian]
   243	    congr 1
   244	    have h := congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose (hAW x a).eq
   245	    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
   246	      measurement_effect_hermitian] at h
   247	    exact h
   248	  have h2 : |ovQ - avgOver μ (fun x =>
   249	      ∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * W x a))| ≤ Real.sqrt ζ := by
   250	    rw [avgOver_congr μ _ _ fun x => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => hWconj x a]
   251	    exact abs_overlap_gap_le_sqrt_of_opFamilyDistSq μ A
   252	      (fun x a => (Q x).effect a) (fun x a => (W x a)ᴴ) ψ hμ hψ ζ hdist
   253	  -- replacing `Q R` by `W R = W`
   254	  have h4 : |avgOver μ (fun x =>
   255	      ∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * ((Q x).effect a * R x a))) -
   256	        avgOver μ (fun x => ∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * W x a))| ≤
   257	      Real.sqrt ζ := by
   258	    have hpt : ∀ x,
   259	        (∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * ((Q x).effect a * R x a))) -
   260	          (∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * W x a)) =
   261	        ∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * (((Q x).effect a - W x a) * R x a)) := by
   262	      intro x
   263	      rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
   264	      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
   265	      rw [sub_mul, hWR]
   266	      simp [stateQForm, applyOperatorToState, mul_sub]
   267	    rw [← avgOver_sub, avgOver_congr μ _ _ hpt]
   268	    have hcs := abs_avgOver_sum_stateQForm_mul_le_sqrt_of_isProj' μ A
   269	      (fun x a => (Q x).effect a - W x a) R ψ hμ hψ hR hAR
   270	      (fun x a => (hAQ x a).sub_right (hAW x a))
   271	    refine hcs.trans (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt ?_)
   272	    have hdist' : avgOver μ (fun x =>
   273	        ∑ a, ‖applyOperatorToState ((Q x).effect a - (W x a)ᴴ) ψ‖ ^ 2) ≤ ζ :=
   274	      hdist
   275	    refine le_of_eq_of_le ?_ hdist'
   276	    refine avgOver_congr μ _ _ fun x => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
   277	    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_sub, measurement_effect_hermitian]
   278	  -- inserting `Q` before `R`
   279	  have h5 : |avgOver μ (fun x =>
   280	      ∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * ((Q x).effect a * R x a))) -
   281	        avgOver μ (fun x => ∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * R x a))| ≤
   282	      Real.sqrt η := by
   283	    have hpt : ∀ x,
   284	        (∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * R x a)) -
   285	          (∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * ((Q x).effect a * R x a))) =
   286	        ∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * ((1 - (Q x).effect a) * R x a)) := by
   287	      intro x
   288	      rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
   289	      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
   290	      simp [stateQForm, applyOperatorToState, sub_mul, mul_sub]
   291	    rw [abs_sub_comm, ← avgOver_sub, avgOver_congr μ _ _ hpt]
   292	    have hcs := abs_avgOver_sum_stateQForm_mul_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt μ A
   293	      (fun x a => 1 - (Q x).effect a) R ψ (fun x a => (hQ x a).one_sub)
   294	      (fun x a => (Commute.one_right _).sub_right (hAQ x a))
   295	    have hfirst : avgOver μ (fun x =>
   296	        ∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * (1 - (Q x).effect a))) = 1 - ovQ := by
   297	      have hx : ∀ x,
   298	          (∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * (1 - (Q x).effect a))) =
   299	            1 - ∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * (Q x).effect a) := by
   300	        intro x
   301	        rw [← sum_stateQForm_effect_eq_one (A x) ψ hψ, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
   302	        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
   303	        simp [stateQForm, applyOperatorToState, mul_sub]
   304	      rw [avgOver_congr μ _ _ hx, avgOver_sub, avgOver_const_of_isProbability μ hμ]
   305	    have hsecond : avgOver μ (fun x =>
   306	        ∑ a, stateQForm (applyOperatorToState (R x a) ψ) ((A x).effect a)) ≤ 1 := by
   307	      rw [avgOver_congr μ _ _ fun x => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ =>
   308	        stateQForm_applyOperatorToState_eq_of_isProj ψ (hR x a) (hAR x a)]
   309	      exact avgOver_sum_stateQForm_mul_le_one μ A R ψ hμ hψ hR hAR
   310	    rw [hfirst] at hcs
   311	    calc
   312	      _ ≤ _ := hcs
   313	      _ ≤ Real.sqrt (1 - ovQ) * 1 := by
   314	        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
   315	        rw [← Real.sqrt_one]
   316	        exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hsecond
   317	      _ = Real.sqrt (1 - ovQ) := mul_one _
   318	      _ ≤ Real.sqrt η := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h1
   319	  have h2' := abs_le.mp h2
   320	  have h4' := abs_le.mp h4
   321	  have h5' := abs_le.mp h5

   326	/-- A pair of line-point pairs of the source space: the sample type of the
   327	consistency display of `lem:qld-xz-lines`. -/
   328	abbrev LinePointPairSample (P : AdmissibleParams) :=

   334	variable {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε δQ δP : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P ε}

   337	/-- The `Z`-point deficit of the evaluated pair-line measurement over a
   338	probability law on pairs of line-point pairs, from the consistency of the
   339	evaluated pair-line measurement with the completed joint point measurement
   340	and the closeness of the latter to the `Z`-then-`X` product.  This is the
   341	deficit bounded in the proof of `lem:claim-17-3`, paper
   342	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1204-1239`. -/
   343	theorem CombinedLinesWitness.one_sub_Z_overlap_le_at
   344	    (lines : CombinedLinesWitness S points δP)
   345	    (first second : Placement) (hopposite : first.IsOpposite second)
   346	    (ν : Distribution (LinePointPairSample P)) (hν : ν.IsProbability) (η ζ : ℝ)
   347	    (hcons : consistencyDefect ν
   348	      (fun s o => S.place first
   349	        (((lines.T first.side s.1.1 s.2.1).postprocess fun fs =>
   350	          (evalOpt s.1.1 s.1.2 fs.1, evalOpt s.2.1 s.2.2 fs.2)).effect o))
   351	      (fun s o => S.place second
   352	        (((points.Q second.side s.1.2 s.2.2).postprocess fun ab =>
   353	          (some ab.1, some ab.2)).effect o))
   354	      S.psiHat ≤ η)
   355	    (hZX : opFamilyDistSq ν
   356	      (fun s o => S.place second
   357	        (((points.Q second.side s.1.2 s.2.2).postprocess fun ab =>
   358	          (some ab.1, some ab.2)).effect o))
   359	      (fun s o => S.place second
   360	        ((S.pointMeasExpOption second.side .Z s.2.2).effect o.2 *
   361	          (S.pointMeasExpOption second.side .X s.1.2).effect o.1))
   362	      S.psiHat ≤ ζ) :
   363	    1 - avgOver ν (fun s =>
   364	      ∑ o : Option (PauliScalar P) × Option (PauliScalar P),
   365	        stateQForm S.psiHat
   366	          (S.place first
   367	            (((lines.T first.side s.1.1 s.2.1).postprocess fun fs =>
   368	              (evalOpt s.1.1 s.1.2 fs.1, evalOpt s.2.1 s.2.2 fs.2)).effect o) *
   369	            S.place second ((S.pointMeasExpOption second.side .Z s.2.2).effect o.2))) ≤
   370	      2 * Real.sqrt η + 2 * Real.sqrt ζ := by
   371	  have hQproj : ∀ s : LinePointPairSample P,
   372	      Measurement.IsProjective (S.placedMeasurement second
   373	        ((points.Q second.side s.1.2 s.2.2).postprocess fun ab => (some ab.1, some ab.2))) :=
   374	    fun s => S.placedMeasurement_isProjective _ _
   375	      (completedPair_isProjective _ (points.projective _ _ _))
   376	  have hRproj : ∀ (s : LinePointPairSample P)
   377	      (o : Option (PauliScalar P) × Option (PauliScalar P)),
   378	      IsProj (S.place second ((S.pointMeasExpOption second.side .Z s.2.2).effect o.2)) :=
   379	    fun s o => S.place_isProj _ (S.pointMeasExpOption_isProj _ _ _ _)
   380	  have hWR : ∀ (s : LinePointPairSample P)
   381	      (o : Option (PauliScalar P) × Option (PauliScalar P)),
   382	      S.place second ((S.pointMeasExpOption second.side .X s.1.2).effect o.1 *
   383	          (S.pointMeasExpOption second.side .Z s.2.2).effect o.2) *
   384	        S.place second ((S.pointMeasExpOption second.side .Z s.2.2).effect o.2) =
   385	      S.place second ((S.pointMeasExpOption second.side .X s.1.2).effect o.1 *
   386	        (S.pointMeasExpOption second.side .Z s.2.2).effect o.2) := by
   387	    intro s o
   388	    have hlocal : (S.pointMeasExpOption second.side .X s.1.2).effect o.1 *
   389	          (S.pointMeasExpOption second.side .Z s.2.2).effect o.2 *
   390	        (S.pointMeasExpOption second.side .Z s.2.2).effect o.2 =
   391	        (S.pointMeasExpOption second.side .X s.1.2).effect o.1 *
   392	          (S.pointMeasExpOption second.side .Z s.2.2).effect o.2 := by
   393	      rw [mul_assoc, (S.pointMeasExpOption_isProj second.side .Z s.2.2 o.2).isIdempotentElem.eq]
   394	    exact (ProjectiveSetting.place_mul S second _ _).symm.trans
   395	      (congrArg (S.place second) hlocal)
   396	  have hnonneg : ∀ (s : LinePointPairSample P)
   397	      (o : Option (PauliScalar P) × Option (PauliScalar P)),
   398	      0 ≤ stateQForm S.psiHat
   399	        (S.place first
   400	          (((lines.T first.side s.1.1 s.2.1).postprocess fun fs =>
   401	            (evalOpt s.1.1 s.1.2 fs.1, evalOpt s.2.1 s.2.2 fs.2)).effect o) *
   402	          S.place second
   403	            (((points.Q second.side s.1.2 s.2.2).postprocess fun ab =>
   404	              (some ab.1, some ab.2)).effect o)) :=
   405	    fun s o => stateQForm_nonneg _ (S.place_mul_place_nonneg first second hopposite
   406	      (((lines.T first.side s.1.1 s.2.1).postprocess fun fs =>
   407	        (evalOpt s.1.1 s.1.2 fs.1, evalOpt s.2.1 s.2.2 fs.2)).pos o)
   408	      (((points.Q second.side s.1.2 s.2.2).postprocess fun ab =>
   409	        (some ab.1, some ab.2)).pos o))
   410	  have hdist : opFamilyDistSq ν
   411	      (fun s o => S.place second
   412	        (((points.Q second.side s.1.2 s.2.2).postprocess fun ab =>
   413	          (some ab.1, some ab.2)).effect o))
   414	      (fun s o => (S.place second
   415	        ((S.pointMeasExpOption second.side .X s.1.2).effect o.1 *
   416	          (S.pointMeasExpOption second.side .Z s.2.2).effect o.2))ᴴ)
   417	      S.psiHat ≤ ζ := by
   418	    refine le_of_eq_of_le ?_ hZX
   419	    unfold opFamilyDistSq
   420	    refine avgOver_congr _ _ _ fun s => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun o _ => ?_
   421	    have hlocal : ((S.pointMeasExpOption second.side .X s.1.2).effect o.1 *
   422	          (S.pointMeasExpOption second.side .Z s.2.2).effect o.2)ᴴ =
   423	        (S.pointMeasExpOption second.side .Z s.2.2).effect o.2 *
   424	          (S.pointMeasExpOption second.side .X s.1.2).effect o.1 := by
   425	      rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
   426	        (S.pointMeasExpOption_isProj second.side .Z s.2.2 o.2).isSelfAdjoint.isHermitian.eq,
   427	        (S.pointMeasExpOption_isProj second.side .X s.1.2 o.1).isSelfAdjoint.isHermitian.eq]
   428	    have hplace : (S.place second
   429	        ((S.pointMeasExpOption second.side .X s.1.2).effect o.1 *
   430	          (S.pointMeasExpOption second.side .Z s.2.2).effect o.2))ᴴ =
   431	        S.place second ((S.pointMeasExpOption second.side .Z s.2.2).effect o.2 *
   432	          (S.pointMeasExpOption second.side .X s.1.2).effect o.1) :=
   433	      (ProjectiveSetting.place_conjTranspose S second _).symm.trans
   434	        (congrArg (S.place second) hlocal)
   435	    dsimp only
   436	    rw [hplace]
   437	  exact one_sub_overlap_le_of_consistencyDefect ν
   438	    (fun s => S.placedMeasurement first
   439	      ((lines.T first.side s.1.1 s.2.1).postprocess fun fs =>
   440	        (evalOpt s.1.1 s.1.2 fs.1, evalOpt s.2.1 s.2.2 fs.2)))
   441	    (fun s => S.placedMeasurement second
   442	      ((points.Q second.side s.1.2 s.2.2).postprocess fun ab => (some ab.1, some ab.2)))
   443	    (fun s o => S.place second ((S.pointMeasExpOption second.side .Z s.2.2).effect o.2))
   444	    (fun s o => S.place second
   445	      ((S.pointMeasExpOption second.side .X s.1.2).effect o.1 *
   446	        (S.pointMeasExpOption second.side .Z s.2.2).effect o.2))
   447	    S.psiHat hν S.psiHat_norm hQproj hRproj
   448	    (fun s o => S.place_comm first second hopposite _ _)
   449	    (fun s o => S.place_comm first second hopposite _ _)
   450	    (fun s o => S.place_comm first second hopposite _ _)
   451	    hWR hnonneg η ζ hcons hdist

   453	/-- The original first-player specialization of the opposite-placement estimate. -/
   454	theorem CombinedLinesWitness.one_sub_Z_overlap_le
   455	    (lines : CombinedLinesWitness S points δP)
   456	    (ν : Distribution (LinePointPairSample P)) (hν : ν.IsProbability) (η ζ : ℝ)
   457	    (hcons : consistencyDefect ν
   458	      (fun s o => S.place .AA'
   459	        (((lines.T .alice s.1.1 s.2.1).postprocess fun fs =>
   460	          (evalOpt s.1.1 s.1.2 fs.1, evalOpt s.2.1 s.2.2 fs.2)).effect o))
   461	      (fun s o => S.place .BA''
   462	        (((points.Q .bob s.1.2 s.2.2).postprocess fun ab =>
   463	          (some ab.1, some ab.2)).effect o))
   464	      S.psiHat ≤ η)
   465	    (hZX : opFamilyDistSq ν
   466	      (fun s o => S.place .BA''
   467	        (((points.Q .bob s.1.2 s.2.2).postprocess fun ab =>
   468	          (some ab.1, some ab.2)).effect o))
   469	      (fun s o => S.place .BA''
   470	        ((S.pointMeasExpOption .bob .Z s.2.2).effect o.2 *
   471	          (S.pointMeasExpOption .bob .X s.1.2).effect o.1))
   472	      S.psiHat ≤ ζ) :
   473	    1 - avgOver ν (fun s =>
   474	      ∑ o : Option (PauliScalar P) × Option (PauliScalar P),

   476	          (S.place .AA'
   477	            (((lines.T .alice s.1.1 s.2.1).postprocess fun fs =>

   479	            S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExpOption .bob .Z s.2.2).effect o.2))) ≤
   480	      2 * Real.sqrt η + 2 * Real.sqrt ζ := by
   481	  exact lines.one_sub_Z_overlap_le_at .AA' .BA'' trivial ν hν η ζ hcons hZX

   488	/-- Every restricted line-point law has total mass one. -/
   489	theorem restrictedLinePointDist_isProbability (P : AdmissibleParams)
   490	    (kind : LineKind) (i : Fin P.m) :
   491	    (restrictedLinePointDist P kind i).IsProbability := by
   492	  cases kind
   493	  · change (restrictedALineDist P.toLdParams i).IsProbability
   494	    exact restrictedALineDist_isProbability P.toLdParams i
   495	  · change (restrictedDLineDist P.toLdParams i).IsProbability
   496	    exact restrictedDLineDist_isProbability P.toLdParams i
   497	
   498	/-- The point marginal of a restricted line-point law is uniform. -/
   499	theorem restrictedLinePointDist_map_snd (P : AdmissibleParams) (kind : LineKind)
   500	    (i : Fin P.m) :
   501	    (restrictedLinePointDist P kind i).map Prod.snd =
   502	      uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) := by
   503	  rw [restrictedLinePointDist_eq_map_prod, Distribution.map_map]
   504	  exact Distribution.prod_map_fst _ _ (Distribution.prod_isProbability _ _
   505	    (subLineSeedDist_isProbability P i) (uniformDistribution_isProbability _))
   506	
   507	/-- The pair of points of a product of two restricted line-point laws is a
   508	uniform pair. -/
   509	theorem prod_restrictedLinePointDist_map_points (P : AdmissibleParams)
   510	    (kindX kindZ : LineKind) (i j : Fin P.m) :
   511	    (Distribution.prod (restrictedLinePointDist P kindX i)
   512	        (restrictedLinePointDist P kindZ j)).map (fun s => (s.1.2, s.2.2)) =
   513	      uniformDistribution
   514	        ((Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) × (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) := by
   515	  have h : Distribution.prod ((restrictedLinePointDist P kindX i).map Prod.snd)
   516	      ((restrictedLinePointDist P kindZ j).map Prod.snd) =
   517	      uniformDistribution
   518	        ((Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) × (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) := by
   519	    rw [restrictedLinePointDist_map_snd, restrictedLinePointDist_map_snd,
   520	      uniformDistribution_prod]
   521	  rw [← h, Distribution.prod_map_left, Distribution.prod_map_right,
   522	    Distribution.map_map]
   523	
   524	/-- A state-dependent distance between two families depending on the pair of
   525	points only, averaged over a product of two restricted line-point laws, is the
   526	distance averaged over a uniform pair of points. -/
   527	theorem opFamilyDistSq_prod_restricted_points {α ι : Type*} [Fintype α]
   528	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (P : AdmissibleParams) (kindX kindZ : LineKind)
   529	    (i j : Fin P.m)
   530	    (F G : (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) × (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) → α → Op ι)
   531	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   532	    opFamilyDistSq
   533	        (Distribution.prod (restrictedLinePointDist P kindX i)
   534	          (restrictedLinePointDist P kindZ j))
   535	        (fun s a => F (s.1.2, s.2.2) a) (fun s a => G (s.1.2, s.2.2) a) ψ =
   536	      opFamilyDistSq
   537	        (uniformDistribution
   538	          ((Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) × (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))) F G ψ := by
   539	  unfold opFamilyDistSq
   540	  rw [← prod_restrictedLinePointDist_map_points P kindX kindZ i j,
   541	    Distribution.avgOver_map]

   548	/-- The `Z`-point deficit over a product of two restricted line-point laws,
   549	with the inflation `4 m ^ 2` of the line consistency error and the inflation
   550	`4` of the point consistency error. -/
   551	theorem CombinedLinesWitness.one_sub_Z_overlap_restricted_le_at
   552	    (lines : CombinedLinesWitness S points δP)
   553	    (first second : Placement) (hopposite : first.IsOpposite second) (kindX kindZ : LineKind)
   554	    (i j : Fin P.m) :
   555	    1 - avgOver
   556	      (Distribution.prod (restrictedLinePointDist P kindX i)
   557	        (restrictedLinePointDist P kindZ j))
   558	      (fun s => ∑ o : Option (PauliScalar P) × Option (PauliScalar P),
   559	        stateQForm S.psiHat
   560	          (S.place first
   561	            (((lines.T first.side s.1.1 s.2.1).postprocess fun fs =>
   562	              (evalOpt s.1.1 s.1.2 fs.1, evalOpt s.2.1 s.2.2 fs.2)).effect o) *
   563	            S.place second ((S.pointMeasExpOption second.side .Z s.2.2).effect o.2))) ≤
   564	      2 * Real.sqrt (4 * (P.m : ℝ) ^ 2 * δP) + 2 * Real.sqrt (4 * δQ) := by
   565	  refine lines.one_sub_Z_overlap_le_at first second hopposite _
   566	    (Distribution.prod_isProbability _ _
   567	      (restrictedLinePointDist_isProbability P kindX i)
   568	      (restrictedLinePointDist_isProbability P kindZ j)) _ _ ?_ ?_
   569	  · unfold consistencyDefect at ⊢
   570	    refine le_trans
   571	      (avgOver_prod_restrictedLinePointDist_le _ ?_ kindX kindZ i j) ?_
   572	    · intro sample
   573	      exact consistencyDefect_integrand_nonneg S first second hopposite
   574	        ((lines.T first.side sample.1.1 sample.2.1).postprocess fun fs =>
   575	          (evalOpt sample.1.1 sample.1.2 fs.1, evalOpt sample.2.1 sample.2.2 fs.2))
   576	        ((points.Q second.side sample.1.2 sample.2.2).postprocess fun ab =>
   577	          (some ab.1, some ab.2))
   578	    · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (lines.consistent first second hopposite) (by positivity)
   579	  · calc
   580	      _ = opFamilyDistSq
   581	            (uniformDistribution
   582	              ((Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) × (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)))
   583	            (fun xz o => S.place second
   584	              (((points.Q second.side xz.1 xz.2).postprocess fun ab =>
   585	                (some ab.1, some ab.2)).effect o))
   586	            (fun xz o => S.place second
   587	              ((S.pointMeasExpOption second.side .Z xz.2).effect o.2 *
   588	                (S.pointMeasExpOption second.side .X xz.1).effect o.1))
   589	            S.psiHat :=
   590	        opFamilyDistSq_prod_restricted_points P kindX kindZ i j _ _ _
   591	      _ = opFamilyDistSq
   592	            (uniformDistribution
   593	              ((Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) × (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)))
   594	            (fun xz ab => S.place second ((points.Q second.side xz.1 xz.2).effect ab))
   595	            (fun xz ab => S.place second
   596	              ((S.pointMeasExp second.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2 *
   597	                (S.pointMeasExp second.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1))
   598	            S.psiHat := by
   599	        unfold opFamilyDistSq
   600	        exact avgOver_congr _ _ _ fun xz =>
   601	          S.completedPair_norm_sq_sum_ZX points second xz.1 xz.2
   602	      _ ≤ 4 * δQ := points.orderedZX_dist_le second

     4	/-!
     5	# Replacing one factor of a measurement-weighted overlap
     6	
     7	The scalar estimates used to combine the two Pauli bases compare averaged
     8	overlaps whose left factor is one complete measurement and whose right factors
     9	are operator families at small state-dependent distance.  This module records
    10	the corresponding Cauchy--Schwarz estimate.  The right-hand families are
    11	arbitrary, so the estimate covers an ordered product of point effects, which
    12	is not itself a measurement.
    13	
    14	## References
    15	
    16	The estimate is `lem:overlap-gap-distance` in
    17	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex`; it is the Cauchy--Schwarz
    18	step at paper
    19	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1147-1166`.
    20	-/
    21	
    22	open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
    23	
    24	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    25	
    26	open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
    27	open MIPStarRE.Quantum MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus
    28	
    29	/-- Replacing one operator family inside an overlap weighted on the left by a
    30	complete measurement changes the average by at most the square root of the
    31	state-dependent squared distance between the two families. -/
    32	theorem abs_overlap_gap_le_sqrt_of_opFamilyDistSq {X α ι : Type*}
    33	    [Fintype α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    34	    (μ : Distribution X) (A : X → Measurement α ι) (B C : X → α → Op ι)
    35	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (hμ : μ.IsProbability) (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1)
    36	    (ζ : ℝ) (hBC : opFamilyDistSq μ B C ψ ≤ ζ) :
    37	    |avgOver μ (fun x => ∑ a : α, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * B x a)) -
    38	        avgOver μ (fun x => ∑ a : α, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * C x a))| ≤
    39	      Real.sqrt ζ := by
    40	  classical
    41	  have hnorm_sq : ∀ M : Op ι,
    42	      ‖applyOperatorToState M ψ‖ ^ 2 = stateQForm ψ (Mᴴ * M) := by
    43	    intro M
    44	    rw [@norm_sq_eq_re_inner ℂ]
    45	    unfold stateQForm applyOperatorToState
    46	    rw [Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_mul_self]
    47	    change (inner ℂ (Matrix.toEuclideanLin M ψ) (Matrix.toEuclideanLin M ψ)).re =
    48	      (inner ℂ ψ ((Matrix.toEuclideanLin M).adjoint
    49	        (Matrix.toEuclideanLin M ψ))).re
    50	    rw [LinearMap.adjoint_inner_right]
    51	  have hmul : ∀ M N : Op ι, Mᴴ = M →
    52	      stateQForm ψ (M * N) =
    53	        (inner ℂ (applyOperatorToState M ψ)
    54	          (applyOperatorToState N ψ)).re := by
    55	    intro M N hM
    56	    have hadjoint : (Matrix.toEuclideanLin M).adjoint =
    57	        Matrix.toEuclideanLin M := by
    58	      rw [← Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_eq_adjoint, hM]
    59	    calc
    60	      stateQForm ψ (M * N) =
    61	          (inner ℂ ψ
    62	            (applyOperatorToState M (applyOperatorToState N ψ))).re := by
    63	        rw [stateQForm, applyOperatorToState_mul]
    64	      _ = (inner ℂ ψ ((Matrix.toEuclideanLin M).adjoint
    65	            (applyOperatorToState N ψ))).re := by
    66	        rw [hadjoint]
    67	        rfl
    68	      _ = _ := by
    69	        rw [LinearMap.adjoint_inner_right]
    70	        rfl
    71	  have hleft : ∀ x : X,
    72	      (∑ a : α, ‖applyOperatorToState ((A x).effect a) ψ‖ ^ 2) ≤ 1 := by
    73	    intro x
    74	    have htotal : (∑ a : α, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a)) = 1 := by
    75	      calc

   144	/-! ## The Cauchy--Schwarz inequality weighted by a positive operator -/
   145	
   146	/-- For a positive operator `A`, the sesquilinear form `⟨u, A v⟩` satisfies the
   147	Cauchy--Schwarz inequality with the two diagonal values `⟨u, A u⟩` and
   148	`⟨v, A v⟩`.  This is the inequality behind the Cauchy--Schwarz steps of the
   149	proofs of `lem:claim-17-2` and `lem:claim-17-3`, in which both factors carry
   150	the square root of the line effect, paper
   151	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1168-1209`. -/
   152	theorem norm_inner_applyOperatorToState_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt {ι : Type*}
   153	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {A : Op ι} (hA : 0 ≤ A)
   154	    (u v : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   155	    ‖inner ℂ u (applyOperatorToState A v)‖ ≤
   156	      Real.sqrt (inner ℂ u (applyOperatorToState A u)).re *
   157	        Real.sqrt (inner ℂ v (applyOperatorToState A v)).re := by
   158	  set R : Op ι := CFC.sqrt A with hR
   159	  have hRnonneg : 0 ≤ R := CFC.sqrt_nonneg A
   160	  have hRR : R * R = A := CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self A hA
   161	  have hRherm : Rᴴ = R :=
   162	    (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp hRnonneg).isHermitian.eq
   163	  have hadjoint : (Matrix.toEuclideanLin R).adjoint = Matrix.toEuclideanLin R := by
   164	    rw [← Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_eq_adjoint, hRherm]
   165	  have hsplit : ∀ w z : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι,
   166	      inner ℂ w (applyOperatorToState A z) =
   167	        inner ℂ (applyOperatorToState R w) (applyOperatorToState R z) := by
   168	    intro w z
   169	    have h := LinearMap.adjoint_inner_right (Matrix.toEuclideanLin R) w
   170	      (Matrix.toEuclideanLin R z)
   171	    rw [hadjoint] at h
   172	    rw [← hRR, applyOperatorToState_mul]
   173	    exact h
   174	  have hnorm : ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι,
   175	      ‖applyOperatorToState R w‖ =
   176	        Real.sqrt (inner ℂ w (applyOperatorToState A w)).re := by
   177	    intro w
   178	    have h2 : ‖applyOperatorToState R w‖ ^ 2 =
   179	        (inner ℂ (applyOperatorToState R w) (applyOperatorToState R w)).re := by
   180	      rw [@norm_sq_eq_re_inner ℂ]
   181	      rfl
   182	    rw [hsplit, ← h2, Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)]
   183	  rw [hsplit, ← hnorm, ← hnorm]
   184	  exact norm_inner_le_norm _ _

   186	/-- The sum over outcomes of the real parts of `⟨u a, A a (v a)⟩`, for
   187	positive weights `A a`, is bounded by the product of the square roots of the
   188	two diagonal sums. -/
   189	theorem abs_sum_re_inner_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt {α ι : Type*} [Fintype α]
   190	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : α → Op ι) (hA : ∀ a, 0 ≤ A a)
   191	    (u v : α → EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   192	    |∑ a, (inner ℂ (u a) (applyOperatorToState (A a) (v a))).re| ≤
   193	      Real.sqrt (∑ a, (inner ℂ (u a) (applyOperatorToState (A a) (u a))).re) *
   194	        Real.sqrt (∑ a, (inner ℂ (v a) (applyOperatorToState (A a) (v a))).re) := by
   195	  have hu : ∀ a, 0 ≤ (inner ℂ (u a) (applyOperatorToState (A a) (u a))).re :=
   196	    fun a => stateQForm_nonneg (u a) (hA a)
   197	  have hv : ∀ a, 0 ≤ (inner ℂ (v a) (applyOperatorToState (A a) (v a))).re :=
   198	    fun a => stateQForm_nonneg (v a) (hA a)
   199	  calc
   200	    |∑ a, (inner ℂ (u a) (applyOperatorToState (A a) (v a))).re|
   201	        ≤ ∑ a, |(inner ℂ (u a) (applyOperatorToState (A a) (v a))).re| :=
   202	      Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
   203	    _ ≤ ∑ a, Real.sqrt (inner ℂ (u a) (applyOperatorToState (A a) (u a))).re *
   204	          Real.sqrt (inner ℂ (v a) (applyOperatorToState (A a) (v a))).re := by
   205	      refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ => ?_
   206	      exact (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans
   207	        (norm_inner_applyOperatorToState_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt (hA a) (u a) (v a))
   208	    _ ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ a,
   209	            Real.sqrt (inner ℂ (u a) (applyOperatorToState (A a) (u a))).re ^ 2) *
   210	          Real.sqrt (∑ a,
   211	            Real.sqrt (inner ℂ (v a) (applyOperatorToState (A a) (v a))).re ^ 2) :=
   212	      Real.sum_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt _ _ _
   213	    _ = _ := by
   214	      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Real.sq_sqrt (hu a),
   215	        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Real.sq_sqrt (hv a)]
   216	
   217	/-- The averaged form of the preceding estimate: the average over a
   218	distribution of the outcome sums of `Re ⟨u, A v⟩` is bounded by the product of
   219	the square roots of the two averaged diagonal sums. -/
   220	theorem abs_avgOver_sum_re_inner_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt {X α ι : Type*} [Fintype α]
   221	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (μ : Distribution X) (A : X → α → Op ι)
   222	    (hA : ∀ x a, 0 ≤ A x a) (u v : X → α → EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   223	    |avgOver μ (fun x =>
   224	        ∑ a, (inner ℂ (u x a) (applyOperatorToState (A x a) (v x a))).re)| ≤
   225	      Real.sqrt (avgOver μ (fun x =>
   226	          ∑ a, (inner ℂ (u x a) (applyOperatorToState (A x a) (u x a))).re)) *
   227	        Real.sqrt (avgOver μ (fun x =>
   228	          ∑ a, (inner ℂ (v x a) (applyOperatorToState (A x a) (v x a))).re)) := by
   229	  set f : X → ℝ := fun x =>
   230	    ∑ a, (inner ℂ (u x a) (applyOperatorToState (A x a) (v x a))).re with hf
   231	  set g : X → ℝ := fun x =>
   232	    ∑ a, (inner ℂ (u x a) (applyOperatorToState (A x a) (u x a))).re with hg
   233	  set h : X → ℝ := fun x =>
   234	    ∑ a, (inner ℂ (v x a) (applyOperatorToState (A x a) (v x a))).re with hh
   235	  have hg0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ g x := fun x =>
   236	    Finset.sum_nonneg fun a _ => stateQForm_nonneg (u x a) (hA x a)
   237	  have hh0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ h x := fun x =>
   238	    Finset.sum_nonneg fun a _ => stateQForm_nonneg (v x a) (hA x a)
   239	  have hpoint : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ Real.sqrt (g x) * Real.sqrt (h x) := fun x =>
   240	    abs_sum_re_inner_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt (A x) (hA x) (u x) (v x)
   241	  unfold avgOver
   242	  calc
   243	    |∑ x ∈ μ.support, μ.weight x * f x|
   244	        ≤ ∑ x ∈ μ.support, |μ.weight x * f x| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
   245	    _ = ∑ x ∈ μ.support, μ.weight x * |f x| := by
   246	      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
   247	      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (μ.nonnegative x)]
   248	    _ ≤ ∑ x ∈ μ.support, μ.weight x * (Real.sqrt (g x) * Real.sqrt (h x)) :=
   249	      Finset.sum_le_sum fun x _ =>
   250	        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hpoint x) (μ.nonnegative x)
   251	    _ = ∑ x ∈ μ.support,
   252	          Real.sqrt (μ.weight x * g x) * Real.sqrt (μ.weight x * h x) := by
   253	      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
   254	      rw [Real.sqrt_mul (μ.nonnegative x), Real.sqrt_mul (μ.nonnegative x),
   255	        show Real.sqrt (μ.weight x) * Real.sqrt (g x) *
   256	            (Real.sqrt (μ.weight x) * Real.sqrt (h x)) =
   257	          Real.sqrt (μ.weight x) * Real.sqrt (μ.weight x) *
   258	            (Real.sqrt (g x) * Real.sqrt (h x)) by ring,
   259	        Real.mul_self_sqrt (μ.nonnegative x)]
   260	    _ ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ x ∈ μ.support, Real.sqrt (μ.weight x * g x) ^ 2) *
   261	          Real.sqrt (∑ x ∈ μ.support, Real.sqrt (μ.weight x * h x) ^ 2) :=
   262	      Real.sum_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt _ _ _
   263	    _ = _ := by
   264	      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ =>
   265	          Real.sq_sqrt (mul_nonneg (μ.nonnegative x) (hg0 x)),
   266	        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ =>
   267	          Real.sq_sqrt (mul_nonneg (μ.nonnegative x) (hh0 x))]

   271	/-- The real quadratic form is invariant under the conjugate transpose. -/
   272	theorem stateQForm_conjTranspose {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   273	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (M : Op ι) :
   274	    stateQForm ψ Mᴴ = stateQForm ψ M := by
   275	  unfold stateQForm
   276	  change (inner ℂ ψ (Matrix.toEuclideanLin Mᴴ ψ)).re =
   277	    (inner ℂ ψ (Matrix.toEuclideanLin M ψ)).re
   278	  rw [Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_eq_adjoint, LinearMap.adjoint_inner_right,
   279	    ← inner_conj_symm, Complex.conj_re]

   281	/-- Conjugating an operator transfers the outer operator to the state vector. -/
   282	theorem stateQForm_conjTranspose_mul_mul {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   283	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (W M : Op ι) :
   284	    stateQForm ψ (Wᴴ * M * W) = stateQForm (applyOperatorToState W ψ) M := by
   285	  unfold stateQForm
   286	  rw [applyOperatorToState_mul, applyOperatorToState_mul]
   287	  congr 1
   288	  change inner ℂ ψ (Matrix.toEuclideanLin Wᴴ _) =
   289	    inner ℂ (Matrix.toEuclideanLin W ψ) _
   290	  rw [Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_eq_adjoint, LinearMap.adjoint_inner_right]

   296	    (hAB : Commute A B) :

   298	  rw [← stateQForm_conjTranspose_mul_mul, hB.isSelfAdjoint.isHermitian.eq,
   299	    ← hAB.eq, mul_assoc, hB.isIdempotentElem.eq]
   300	
   301	/-- The quadratic form of an operator bounded by the identity is bounded by
   302	the squared norm of the vector. -/

   304	    (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) {A : Op ι} (hA : A ≤ 1) :
   305	    stateQForm v A ≤ ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by
   306	  rw [← stateQForm_one]
   307	  exact quadratic_form_mono hA v

   311	theorem sum_stateQForm_effect_eq_one {α ι : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype ι]

   367	          stateQForm (applyOperatorToState (C x a) ψ) ((A x).effect a))) := by
   368	  have hrw : ∀ x a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * (B x a * C x a)) =

   371	          (applyOperatorToState (C x a) ψ))).re := by

   377	    have hadj : (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (B x a)).adjoint =

   401	/-- Deficit form of the Cauchy--Schwarz estimate: for projections `B` and `C`
