   133	/-- Canonical line descriptions whose coordinate index is stored directly.
   134	Coordinates are numbered from zero, so `index = i` represents coordinate
   135	`i + 1` in the paper. -/
   136	inductive DirectLineDesc (D : DirectLdParams) where
   137	  | axis (base : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) (index : Fin D.m)
   138	      (baseFixed : lineRepMap (coordinateDirection index) base = base)
   139	  | diagonal (base : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) (index : Fin D.m)
   140	      (direction : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)
   141	      (baseFixed : lineRepMap direction base = base)
   142	      (prefixZero : ∀ j : Fin D.m, j.val < index.val → direction j = 0)
   143	  deriving DecidableEq
   144	
   145	/-- The kind of a directly indexed line. -/
   146	def DirectLineDesc.kind {D : DirectLdParams} : DirectLineDesc D → LineKind
   147	  | .axis _ _ _ => .axis
   148	  | .diagonal _ _ _ _ _ => .diagonal
   149	
   150	/-- The coordinate index stored in a directly indexed line. -/
   151	def DirectLineDesc.index {D : DirectLdParams} : DirectLineDesc D → Fin D.m
   152	  | .axis _ index _ => index
   153	  | .diagonal _ index _ _ _ => index
   154	
   155	/-- The canonical base point of a directly indexed line. -/
   156	def DirectLineDesc.base {D : DirectLdParams} :
   157	    DirectLineDesc D → Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D
   158	  | .axis base _ _ => base
   159	  | .diagonal base _ _ _ _ => base
   160	
   161	/-- The geometric direction of a directly indexed line. -/
   162	def DirectLineDesc.direction {D : DirectLdParams} (line : DirectLineDesc D) :
   163	    Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D :=
   164	  match line with
   165	  | .axis _ index _ => coordinateDirection index
   166	  | .diagonal _ _ direction _ _ => direction
   167	
   168	/-- The base of a directly indexed description is fixed by its geometric
   169	direction. -/
   170	theorem DirectLineDesc.base_fixed {D : DirectLdParams} (line : DirectLineDesc D) :
   171	    lineRepMap line.direction line.base = line.base := by
   172	  cases line with
   173	  | axis base index baseFixed => exact baseFixed
   174	  | diagonal base index direction baseFixed prefixZero => exact baseFixed
   175	
   176	/-- Every directly indexed diagonal description retains its prefix-zero
   177	invariant. -/
   178	theorem DirectLineDesc.diagonal_prefix_zero {D : DirectLdParams}
   179	    (line : DirectLineDesc D) (hline : line.kind = .diagonal) :
   180	    ∀ j : Fin D.m, j.val < line.index.val → line.direction j = 0 := by
   181	  cases line with
   182	  | axis base index baseFixed => simp [DirectLineDesc.kind] at hline
   183	  | diagonal base index direction baseFixed prefixZero => exact prefixZero
   184	
   185	/-- The point set represented by a directly indexed line. -/
   186	noncomputable def DirectLineDesc.pointSet {D : DirectLdParams}
   187	    (line : DirectLineDesc D) : Set (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) :=
   188	  linePoints line.base line.direction
   189	
   190	/-- Turn a direct sample into its canonical axis-line description. -/
   191	noncomputable def directALineDescOf (D : DirectLdParams)
   192	    (sample : DirectLdSpace D) : DirectLineDesc D :=
   193	  let direction := coordinateDirection sample.index
   194	  let base := lineRepMap direction sample.point
   195	  .axis base sample.index (lineRepMap_apply_self direction sample.point)
   196	
   197	/-- Turn a direct sample into its canonical diagonal-line description. -/
   198	noncomputable def directDLineDescOf (D : DirectLdParams)
   199	    (sample : DirectLdSpace D) : DirectLineDesc D :=
   200	  let direction := directPrefixProjection sample.index sample.direction
   201	  let base := lineRepMap direction sample.point
   202	  .diagonal base sample.index direction
   203	    (lineRepMap_apply_self direction sample.point) (by
   204	      intro j hj
   205	      change directPrefixProjection sample.index sample.direction j = 0
   206	      rw [directPrefixProjection, if_pos hj])
   207	
   208	/-- The axis-line/point law with a directly sampled coordinate index. -/
   209	noncomputable def directALinePointDist (D : DirectLdParams) :
   210	    Distribution (DirectLineDesc D × (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) :=
   211	  (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace D)).map fun sample =>
   212	    (directALineDescOf D sample, sample.point)
   213	
   214	/-- The diagonal-line/point law with a directly sampled prefix index. -/
   215	noncomputable def directDLinePointDist (D : DirectLdParams) :
   216	    Distribution (DirectLineDesc D × (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) :=
   217	  (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace D)).map fun sample =>
   218	    (directDLineDescOf D sample, sample.point)
   219	
   220	/-- The equal mixture of the directly indexed axis and diagonal line-point
   221	laws.  This is the replacement for the otherwise undefined extended-dimension
   222	instance used at paper
   223	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1020-1116`. -/
   224	noncomputable def directLinePointDist (D : DirectLdParams) :
   225	    Distribution (DirectLineDesc D × (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) :=
   226	  Distribution.mix (1 / 2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
   227	    (directALinePointDist D) (directDLinePointDist D)
   228	
   229	/-- The directly indexed axis-line/point law is probabilistic. -/
   230	theorem directALinePointDist_isProbability (D : DirectLdParams) :
   231	    (directALinePointDist D).IsProbability := by
   232	  exact (uniformDistribution_isProbability (DirectLdSpace D)).map _
   233	
   234	/-- The directly indexed diagonal-line/point law is probabilistic. -/
   235	theorem directDLinePointDist_isProbability (D : DirectLdParams) :
   236	    (directDLinePointDist D).IsProbability := by
   237	  exact (uniformDistribution_isProbability (DirectLdSpace D)).map _
   238	
   239	/-- The directly indexed line-point mixture is probabilistic. -/
   240	theorem directLinePointDist_isProbability (D : DirectLdParams) :
   241	    (directLinePointDist D).IsProbability := by
   242	  exact Distribution.mix_isProbability _ _ _
   243	    (directALinePointDist_isProbability D) (directDLinePointDist_isProbability D)
   244	    (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
   245	
   246	/-- The point and stored-index marginals of the direct axis-line law are
   247	uniform.  This is a direct-index analogue of `lem:alnf`, required by
   248	the repair described in `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`;
   249	the source distribution is at
   250	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:243-257`.
   251	-/
   252	theorem directALinePointDist_point_index_marginal_uniform (D : DirectLdParams) :
   253	    (directALinePointDist D).map Prod.snd =
   254	        uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) ∧
   255	      (directALinePointDist D).map (fun sample => sample.1.index) =
   256	        uniformDistribution (Fin D.m) := by
   257	  constructor
   258	  · unfold directALinePointDist
   259	    rw [Distribution.map_map]
   260	    simpa [Function.comp_def] using
   261	      (uniformDistribution_map_fst_of_equiv
   262	        (e := directLdSpacePointEquiv D)
   263	        (f := fun sample : DirectLdSpace D => sample.point) (by intro; rfl))
   264	  · unfold directALinePointDist
   265	    rw [Distribution.map_map]
   266	    simpa [Function.comp_def, directALineDescOf, DirectLineDesc.index] using
   267	      (uniformDistribution_map_fst_of_equiv
   268	        (e := directLdSpaceIndexEquiv D)
   269	        (f := fun sample : DirectLdSpace D => sample.index) (by intro; rfl))
   270	
   271	/-- Every sampled direct axis line contains its paired point.  This is the
   272	Direct-index incidence obligation corresponding to `lem:alnf` and
   273	the repair in `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`. -/
   274	theorem directALinePointDist_mem_line (D : DirectLdParams) :
   275	    ∀ sample ∈ (directALinePointDist D).support,
   276	      sample.2 ∈ sample.1.pointSet := by
   277	  intro sample hsample
   278	  rw [directALinePointDist, Distribution.map_support,
   279	    uniformDistribution_support] at hsample
   280	  rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hsample with ⟨source, _, rfl⟩
   281	  simpa [directALineDescOf, DirectLineDesc.pointSet,
   282	    DirectLineDesc.base, DirectLineDesc.direction] using
   283	    (mem_linePoints_lineRepMap
   284	      (coordinateDirection source.index) source.point)

70	/-- The three low-degree question types of blueprint
    71	`def:ld-game`, paper origin
    72	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
    73	-/
    74	inductive LdType where
    75	  | point
    76	  | aline
    77	  | dline
    78	  deriving DecidableEq, Repr, Inhabited, Fintype
    79	
    80	/-- The register index used by the low-degree game (blueprint
    81	`def:ld-game`; paper origin
    82	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`).
    83	-/
    84	abbrev LdIndex (P : LdParams) := (Fin P.m ⊕ Unit) ⊕ Fin P.m
    85	
    86	/-- The full ambient low-degree coefficient space (blueprint
    87	`def:ld-game`; paper origin
    88	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`).
    89	-/
    90	abbrev LdSpace (P : LdParams) := LdIndex P → ScalarQ P
    91	
    92	/-- The point coordinates of an ambient low-degree vector in
    93	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
    94	-/
    95	def LdSpace.point {P : LdParams} (z : LdSpace P) : Fin P.m → ScalarQ P :=
    96	  fun i => z (.inl (.inl i))
    97	
    98	/-- The shared scalar coordinate of an ambient low-degree vector in
    99	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   100	-/
   101	def LdSpace.seed {P : LdParams} (z : LdSpace P) : ScalarQ P :=
   102	  z (.inl (.inr ()) )
   103	
   104	/-- The direction coordinates of an ambient low-degree vector in
   105	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   106	-/
   107	def LdSpace.direction {P : LdParams} (z : LdSpace P) : Fin P.m → ScalarQ P :=
   108	  fun i => z (.inr i)
   109	
   110	/-- The zero-based coordinate index corresponding to the paper's map `χ`:
   111	`chiIndex P s` represents `χ(s) - 1` in the fixed field representation.  This
   112	is `eq:chi-func` in blueprint `def:ld-question-distribution`, paper origin
   113	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   114	-/
   115	noncomputable def chiIndex (P : LdParams) (s : ScalarQ P) : Fin P.m := by
   116	  letI : NeZero P.m := ⟨by
   117	    exact Nat.ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one P.hm)⟩
   118	  exact Fin.ofNat P.m ((binaryRepresentation P.model s).val / (P.q / P.m))
   119	
   120	/-! ### Formalization-only coordinate-index fibers
   121	
   122	The following decomposition supplies the equal-fiber calculation used in the
   123	uniform coordinate-index law.
   124	-/
   125	
   126	/-- The common residue set in a fiber of `chiIndex` is nonempty.  This is part
   127	of the exact seed decomposition supporting the balance assertion in
   128	`def:ld-question-distribution`, blueprint `lem:chi-seed-fibers`, paper
   129	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:215-221`.
   130	-/
   131	theorem LdParams.seedFiberCard_pos (L : LdParams) : 0 < L.q / L.m := by
   132	  exact Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd (by
   133	    obtain ⟨n, hn, hq⟩ := L.hq
   134	    rw [hq]
   135	    exact Nat.pow_pos (by decide)) L.hdvd) L.hm
   136	
   137	/-- Divisibility identifies the scalar cardinality with the product of the
   138	coordinate-index cardinality and the common fiber cardinality.  This supports
   139	`lem:chi-seed-fibers` in blueprint chapter 13. -/
   140	theorem LdParams.seedFiberProduct_eq (L : LdParams) :
   141	    L.q = L.m * (L.q / L.m) :=
   142	  (Nat.mul_div_cancel' L.hdvd).symm
   143	
   144	/-- Casting between equal finite cardinalities preserves the underlying
   145	natural-number representative. -/
   146	@[simp] private theorem equivCastFin_val {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) (i : Fin m) :
   147	    (Equiv.cast (congrArg Fin h) i).val = i.val := by
   148	  subst n
   149	  rfl
   150	
   151	/-- A scalar seed is uniquely a coordinate index and a residue in its
   152	`chiIndex` fiber.  This is the exact decomposition underlying
   153	`lem:chi-seed-fibers` in blueprint chapter 13. -/
   154	noncomputable def seedFiberEquiv (L : LdParams) :
   155	    ScalarQ L ≃ Fin L.m × Fin (L.q / L.m) :=
   156	  (binaryRepresentation L.model).trans <|
   157	    (Equiv.cast <| congrArg Fin L.seedFiberProduct_eq).trans
   158	      finProdFinEquiv.symm
   159	
   160	/-- The coordinate component of the exact seed decomposition is `chiIndex`. -/
   161	@[simp] theorem seedFiberEquiv_fst (L : LdParams) (s : ScalarQ L) :
   162	    (seedFiberEquiv L s).1 = chiIndex L s := by
   163	  letI : NeZero L.m := ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one L.hm)⟩
   164	  have hquot : (binaryRepresentation L.model s).val / (L.q / L.m) < L.m := by
   165	    apply (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul L.seedFiberCard_pos).mpr
   166	    rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel' L.hdvd]
   167	    exact (binaryRepresentation L.model s).isLt
   168	  simp only [seedFiberEquiv, Equiv.trans_apply]
   169	  apply Fin.ext
   170	  change
   171	    (Equiv.cast (congrArg Fin L.seedFiberProduct_eq)
   172	      (binaryRepresentation L.model s)).val / (L.q / L.m) =
   173	      (Fin.ofNat L.m ((binaryRepresentation L.model s).val / (L.q / L.m))).val
   174	  rw [equivCastFin_val]
   175	  · exact (Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hquot).symm
   176	  · exact L.seedFiberProduct_eq
   177	
   178	/-- Reconstruct the scalar seed belonging to a coordinate and its fiber
   179	residue. -/
   180	noncomputable def seedOfIndexResidue (L : LdParams)
   181	    (i : Fin L.m) (r : Fin (L.q / L.m)) : ScalarQ L :=
   182	  (seedFiberEquiv L).symm (i, r)
   183	
   184	/-- Decomposing a reconstructed seed recovers its coordinate and residue. -/
   185	@[simp] theorem seedFiberEquiv_seedOfIndexResidue (L : LdParams)
   186	    (i : Fin L.m) (r : Fin (L.q / L.m)) :
   187	    seedFiberEquiv L (seedOfIndexResidue L i r) = (i, r) :=
   188	  (seedFiberEquiv L).apply_symm_apply (i, r)
   189	
   190	/-- A reconstructed seed belongs to the prescribed `chiIndex` fiber. -/
   191	@[simp] theorem chiIndex_seedOfIndexResidue (L : LdParams)
   192	    (i : Fin L.m) (r : Fin (L.q / L.m)) :
   193	    chiIndex L (seedOfIndexResidue L i r) = i := by
   194	  rw [← seedFiberEquiv_fst]
   195	  simp
   196	
   197	/-- The projection used in the diagonal-line map zeroes coordinates before the
   198	chosen index and retains the suffix of the direction vector.  This is the
   199	prefix restriction in blueprint
   200	`def:ld-question-distribution`, paper origin
   201	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   202	-/
   203	def prefixProjection {P : LdParams} (i : Fin P.m) (v : Fin P.m → ScalarQ P) :
   204	    Fin P.m → ScalarQ P :=
   205	  fun j => if j.val < i.val then 0 else v j
   206	
   207	/-- Zeroing the coordinates preceding a fixed index is idempotent.  This is a
   208	formalization-only consequence of the prefix restriction in
   209	`def:ld-question-distribution`, recorded as `lem:prefix-projection-idempotent`
   210	in blueprint chapter 13. -/
   211	theorem prefixProjection_idempotent {P : LdParams} (i : Fin P.m)
   212	    (v : Fin P.m → ScalarQ P) :
   213	    prefixProjection i (prefixProjection i v) = prefixProjection i v := by
   214	  funext j
   215	  by_cases h : j.val < i.val
   216	  · simp only [prefixProjection, if_pos h]
   217	  · simp only [prefixProjection, if_neg h]
   218	
   219	/-- The point CL map, retaining the point block and clearing the auxiliary
   220	blocks.  It is the map `L_point` of blueprint
   221	`def:ld-question-distribution`, paper origin
   222	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   223	-/
   224	def ldPointCL (P : LdParams) (z : LdSpace P) : LdSpace P :=
   225	  fun i => match i with
   226	  | .inl (.inl j) => z (.inl (.inl j))
   227	  | .inl (.inr _) => 0
   228	  | .inr _ => 0
   229	
   230	/-- The affine-line CL map.  The direction block is put through the canonical
   231	line representative map from `def:line-representative`, while the point block
   232	is retained (blueprint `def:ld-question-distribution`; paper
   233	origin `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`).
   234	-/
   235	noncomputable def ldALineCL (P : LdParams) (z : LdSpace P) : LdSpace P :=
   236	  let i := chiIndex P (z.seed)
   237	  let rep := lineRepMap (coordinateDirection i)
   238	  fun i => match i with
   239	  | .inl (.inl j) => (rep (z.point)) j
   240	  | .inl (.inr _) => z (.inl (.inr ()))
   241	  | .inr _ => 0
   242	
   243	/-- The diagonal-line CL map applies the canonical line representative map to
   244	the point block and stores the prefix-projected direction in the direction
   245	block.  This is the `L_DLine` clause of
   246	`def:ld-question-distribution` (blueprint
   247	`def:ld-question-distribution`; paper origin
   248	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`).
   249	-/
   250	noncomputable def ldDLineCL (P : LdParams) (z : LdSpace P) : LdSpace P :=
   251	  let i := chiIndex P (z.seed)
   252	  let direction := prefixProjection i (z.direction)
   253	  let rep := lineRepMap direction
   254	  fun i => match i with
   255	  | .inl (.inl j) => (rep (z.point)) j
   256	  | .inl (.inr _) => z (.inl (.inr ()))
   257	  | .inr j => direction j
   258	
   259	/-- The conditionally linear map attached to each low-degree question type.
   260	This is the typed construction in blueprint
   261	`def:ld-question-distribution`, paper origin
   262	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   263	-/
   264	noncomputable def ldCL (P : LdParams) : LdType → LdSpace P → LdSpace P
   265	  | .point => ldPointCL P
   266	  | .aline => ldALineCL P
   267	  | .dline => ldDLineCL P
   268	
   269	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the register carrying the shared scalar
   270	coordinate of the ambient low-degree space.  It is the first register in the
   271	concatenation exhibiting the conditional-linearity levels asserted in
   272	blueprint
   273	`def:ld-question-distribution`, paper origin
   274	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`. -/
   275	private def ldSeedRegister (P : LdParams) : Finset (LdIndex P) :=
   276	  {Sum.inl (Sum.inr ())}
   277	
   278	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the register carrying the point coordinates
   279	of the ambient low-degree space; see `ldSeedRegister`. -/
   280	private def ldPointRegister (P : LdParams) : Finset (LdIndex P) :=
   281	  Finset.univ.image fun j : Fin P.m => (Sum.inl (Sum.inl j) : LdIndex P)
   282	
   283	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the register carrying the direction
   284	coordinates of the ambient low-degree space; see `ldSeedRegister`. -/
   285	private def ldDirectionRegister (P : LdParams) : Finset (LdIndex P) :=
   286	  Finset.univ.image fun j : Fin P.m => (Sum.inr j : LdIndex P)
   287	
   288	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the linear map retaining the shared scalar
   289	coordinate and clearing every other coordinate. -/
   290	private def ldSeedLinear (P : LdParams) :
   291	    LdSpace P →ₗ[ScalarQ P] LdSpace P where
   292	  toFun x := fun i =>
   293	    match i with
   294	    | .inl (.inl _) => 0
   295	    | .inl (.inr _) => x (Sum.inl (Sum.inr ()))
   296	    | .inr _ => 0
   297	  map_add' x y := by
   298	    funext i
   299	    rcases i with (j | u) | j <;> simp
   300	  map_smul' c x := by
   301	    funext i
   302	    rcases i with (j | u) | j <;> simp
   303	
   304	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the linear map sending the point block to its
   305	canonical line representative in the fixed direction `v` and clearing every
   306	other coordinate. -/
   307	private noncomputable def ldPointCLLinear (P : LdParams) (v : Fin P.m → ScalarQ P) :
   308	    LdSpace P →ₗ[ScalarQ P] LdSpace P where
   309	  toFun x := fun i =>
   310	    match i with
   311	    | .inl (.inl j) => lineRepMap v (LdSpace.point x) j
   312	    | .inl (.inr _) => 0
   313	    | .inr _ => 0
   314	  map_add' x y := by
   315	    funext i
   316	    rcases i with (j | u) | j
   317	    · change lineRepMap v (LdSpace.point (x + y)) j = _
   318	      have hpoint : LdSpace.point (x + y) = LdSpace.point x + LdSpace.point y := rfl
   319	      rw [hpoint, map_add]
   320	      rfl
   321	    · simp
   322	    · simp
   323	  map_smul' c x := by
   324	    funext i
   325	    rcases i with (j | u) | j
   326	    · change lineRepMap v (LdSpace.point (c • x)) j = _
   327	      have hpoint : LdSpace.point (c • x) = c • LdSpace.point x := rfl
   328	      rw [hpoint, map_smul]
   329	      rfl
   330	    · simp
   331	    · simp
   332	
   333	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the linear map zeroing the first `i`
   334	coordinates of the direction block and clearing every other coordinate. -/
   335	private def ldDirectionCLLinear (P : LdParams) (i : Fin P.m) :
   336	    LdSpace P →ₗ[ScalarQ P] LdSpace P where
   337	  toFun x := fun k =>
   338	    match k with
   339	    | .inl (.inl _) => 0
   340	    | .inl (.inr _) => 0

     8	/-!
     9	# Low-degree polynomial measurements and soundness
    10	
    11	The low-degree question laws have uniform point and coordinate-index marginals,
    12	and every sampled line is incident to its paired point.  Polynomial outcomes
    13	are bounded multivariate polynomials, and the corresponding projective
    14	strategies satisfy the low-degree soundness theorem used in the QPBT argument.
    15	
    16	## References
    17	
    18	The principal definition and theorem are blueprint `def:ld-meas` and
    19	`lem:ld-soundness`. Their paper origin is
    20	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:243-287,392-480`.
    21	The dimension-divisibility hypothesis is documented in
    22	`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`.
    23	-/
    24	
    25	open scoped BigOperators
    26	
    27	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    28	
    29	open MIPStarRE.LDT
    30	open MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries
    31	open MIPStarRE.Quantum
    32	
    33	noncomputable section
    34	
    35	/-!
    36	### Formalization-only auxiliary facts about the ambient low-degree space
    37	-/
    38	
    39	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary equivalence splitting an ambient low-degree
    40	vector into its point, seed, and direction blocks. -/
    41	private def ldSpaceSplit (L : LdParams) :
    42	    LdSpace L ≃ ((Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) × ScalarQ L) × (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) where

     4	/-!
     5	# Independent blocks of the restricted line-point laws
     6	
     7	This module isolates the independent generating blocks of the restricted
     8	line-point laws used by the sampling procedure of the sub-line lemma.  A
     9	uniformly sampled low-degree vector splits into a point block and a
    10	seed-direction block; the coordinate-index event constrains only the second
    11	block, so conditioning on it leaves the point block uniform and independent.
    12	The conditioned seed-direction block is the fresh diagonal direction pair of
    13	the sub-line construction, and the uniform mixture of those pairs over the
    14	coordinate index is the unconditioned law.
    15	
    16	## References
    17	
    18	The generating descriptions support `lem:qld-sublines` in
    19	blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, whose source is
    20	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`.
    21	The restricted laws themselves are `def:ith-restricted-line`, blueprint lines
    22	1209--1228, paper lines 1038--1048.
    23	-/

    35	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the uniform law on a product of two finite
    36	types is the product of the uniform laws.  Blueprint
    37	`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
    38	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
    39	theorem uniformDistribution_prod (α β : Type*) [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    40	    [Nonempty α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [Nonempty β] :
    41	    uniformDistribution (α × β) =
    42	      Distribution.prod (uniformDistribution α) (uniformDistribution β) := by
    43	  classical
    44	  have ha : (Fintype.card α : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    45	    exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero (α := α)
    46	  have hb : (Fintype.card β : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    47	    exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero (α := β)
    48	  refine Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight ?_ ?_
    49	  · show (Finset.univ : Finset (α × β)) =
    50	      (Finset.univ : Finset α).product (Finset.univ : Finset β)
    51	    ext p
    52	    simp
    53	  · funext p
    54	    show (uniformDistribution (α × β)).weight p =
    55	      (uniformDistribution α).weight p.1 * (uniformDistribution β).weight p.2
    56	    rw [uniformDistribution_weight_apply, uniformDistribution_weight_apply,
    57	      uniformDistribution_weight_apply, Fintype.card_prod]
    58	    push_cast
    59	    field_simp

    64	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/

    68	    ∑ w ∈ (uniformDistribution (α × β)).support.filter (fun w => p w.2),

    70	      ∑ b ∈ (uniformDistribution β).support.filter p,
    71	        (uniformDistribution β).weight b := by
    72	  classical
    73	  rw [Distribution.sum_filter_weight_eq_avgOver,
    74	    Distribution.sum_filter_weight_eq_avgOver,
    75	    ← uniformDistribution_map_snd (α := α) (β := β), Distribution.avgOver_map]

    79	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: normalized restriction depends on the

    81	`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
    82	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
    83	theorem Distribution.restrict_congr {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
    84	    {μ ν : Distribution α} (h : μ = ν) (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
    85	    (hμ : 0 < ∑ a ∈ μ.support.filter p, μ.weight a)
    86	    (hν : 0 < ∑ a ∈ ν.support.filter p, ν.weight a) :
    87	    Distribution.restrict μ p hμ = Distribution.restrict ν p hν := by
    88	  subst h

    91	/-- Restricting a product law to an event depending on the second factor alone
    92	leaves the first factor unchanged and independent of the conditioned second
    93	factor.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
    94	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
    95	theorem Distribution.restrict_prod_snd {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
    96	    [DecidableEq β] (μ : Distribution α) (ν : Distribution β)
    97	    (hμ : μ.IsProbability) (p : β → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
    98	    (hpos : 0 < ∑ b ∈ ν.support.filter p, ν.weight b)
    99	    (hpos' : 0 < ∑ w ∈ (Distribution.prod μ ν).support.filter
   100	        (fun w => p w.2), (Distribution.prod μ ν).weight w) :
   101	    Distribution.restrict (Distribution.prod μ ν) (fun w => p w.2) hpos' =
   102	      Distribution.prod μ (Distribution.restrict ν p hpos) := by
   103	  classical
   104	  have hprodsupp : (Distribution.prod μ ν).support =
   105	      μ.support ×ˢ ν.support := rfl
   106	  have hsupp : (Distribution.prod μ ν).support.filter (fun w => p w.2) =
   107	      μ.support ×ˢ (ν.support.filter p) := by
   108	    rw [hprodsupp]
   109	    ext w
   110	    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product]
   111	    tauto
   112	  have hmass : (∑ w ∈ (Distribution.prod μ ν).support.filter
   113	        (fun w => p w.2), (Distribution.prod μ ν).weight w) =
   114	      ∑ b ∈ ν.support.filter p, ν.weight b := by
   115	    rw [hsupp]
   116	    have h1 : (∑ w ∈ μ.support ×ˢ (ν.support.filter p),
   117	        (Distribution.prod μ ν).weight w) =
   118	        ∑ a ∈ μ.support, ∑ b ∈ ν.support.filter p,
   119	          μ.weight a * ν.weight b := by
   120	      rw [Finset.sum_product]
   121	      rfl

   123	        (Finset.mul_sum (ν.support.filter p) (fun b => ν.weight b)
   124	          (μ.weight a)).symm,
   125	      ← Finset.sum_mul, hμ.weight_sum_eq_one, one_mul]
   126	  refine Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight ?_ ?_
   127	  · show (Distribution.prod μ ν).support.filter (fun w => p w.2) =
   128	      μ.support ×ˢ (ν.support.filter p)
   129	    exact hsupp
   130	  · funext w
   131	    show (if p w.2 then (Distribution.prod μ ν).weight w /
   132	        ∑ c ∈ (Distribution.prod μ ν).support.filter (fun w => p w.2),

   134	      μ.weight w.1 * (if p w.2 then ν.weight w.2 /
   135	        ∑ c ∈ ν.support.filter p, ν.weight c else 0)
   136	    rw [hmass]
   137	    by_cases h : p w.2
   138	    · rw [if_pos h, if_pos h]

   140	      rw [mul_div_assoc]
   141	    · rw [if_neg h, if_neg h, mul_zero]

   193	def ldSeedDirEvent (L : LdParams) (i : Fin L.m)

   207	`lem:restricted-line-mixture-bounds`, paper
   208	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1049-1051`. -/

   210	    ∑ sw ∈ (uniformDistribution
   211	          (ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L))).support.filter
   212	        (ldSeedDirEvent L i),
   213	        (uniformDistribution
   214	          (ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L))).weight sw =
   215	      1 / (L.m : ℝ) := by
   216	  classical
   217	  have hmap : (uniformDistribution
   218	        (ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L))).map
   219	        (fun sw => chiIndex L sw.1) = uniformDistribution (Fin L.m) := by
   220	    rw [← Distribution.map_map _ Prod.fst (chiIndex L),
   221	      uniformDistribution_map_fst, uniformDistribution_map_chiIndex]
   222	  rw [Distribution.sum_filter_weight_eq_avgOver,
   223	    show (fun sw : ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) =>
   224	        if ldSeedDirEvent L i sw then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
   225	      fun sw => (fun j : Fin L.m => if j = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
   226	        (chiIndex L sw.1) from rfl,
   227	    ← Distribution.avgOver_map
   228	      (uniformDistribution (ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L)))
   229	      (fun sw => chiIndex L sw.1)
   230	      (fun j : Fin L.m => if j = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0), hmap]
   231	  unfold avgOver
   232	  simp [uniformDistribution_weight_apply, mul_ite]
   233	
   234	/-- Every coordinate-index event of the seed-direction block has positive
   235	mass.  Blueprint `def:ith-restricted-line`, paper
   236	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1038-1048`. -/
   237	theorem ldSeedDirEvent_positive (L : LdParams) (i : Fin L.m) :
   238	    0 < ∑ sw ∈ (uniformDistribution
   239	          (ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L))).support.filter
   240	        (ldSeedDirEvent L i),
   241	      (uniformDistribution
   242	        (ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L))).weight sw := by
   243	  rw [ldSeedDirEvent_mass]
   244	  have hm : (0 : ℝ) < (L.m : ℝ) := by
   245	    exact_mod_cast lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one L.hm
   246	  positivity
   247	
   248	/-! ## Fresh diagonal direction pairs -/
   249	
   250	/-- The fresh diagonal direction pair at coordinate index `i`: a scalar seed
   251	uniform in the fiber of `i` together with a direction block uniform on the
   252	whole space.  This is the auxiliary randomness of the sampling procedure of
   253	blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
   254	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
   255	noncomputable def freshDiagonalPairDist (L : LdParams) (i : Fin L.m) :
   256	    Distribution (ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L)) :=
   257	  Distribution.restrict
   258	    (uniformDistribution (ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L)))
   259	    (ldSeedDirEvent L i) (ldSeedDirEvent_positive L i)
   260	
   261	/-- Every fresh diagonal direction pair law has total mass one. -/
   262	theorem freshDiagonalPairDist_isProbability (L : LdParams) (i : Fin L.m) :
   263	    (freshDiagonalPairDist L i).IsProbability :=
   264	  Distribution.restrict_isProbability _ _ (ldSeedDirEvent_positive L i)
   265	
   266	/-- The uniform mixture over the coordinate index of the fresh diagonal
   267	direction pairs is the unconditioned uniform seed-direction law.  Blueprint
   268	`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
   269	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
   270	theorem bind_uniform_freshDiagonalPairDist (L : LdParams) :
   271	    Distribution.bind (uniformDistribution (Fin L.m))
   272	        (freshDiagonalPairDist L) =
   273	      uniformDistribution (ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L)) :=
   274	  Distribution.bind_uniform_restrict_eq _ (ldSeedDirEvent L)
   275	    (ldSeedDirEvent_positive L)
   276	    (fun i => by rw [ldSeedDirEvent_mass, Fintype.card_fin])
   277	    (fun sw => ⟨chiIndex L sw.1, rfl, fun i hi => hi.symm⟩)
   278	
   279	/-! ## Independence of the point block under the coordinate-index event -/
   280	
   281	/-- Conditioning the uniform ambient low-degree law on the coordinate-index
   282	event of its seed leaves the point block uniform and independent of the fresh
   283	diagonal direction pair carried by the seed-direction block.  Blueprint
   284	`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
   285	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
   286	theorem restrict_uniform_ldSeedEvent_map_block (L : LdParams) (i : Fin L.m) :
   287	    (Distribution.restrict (uniformDistribution (LdSpace L)) (ldSeedEvent L i)
   288	        (ldSeedEvent_positive L i)).map (ldSpaceBlockEquiv L) =
   289	      Distribution.prod (uniformDistribution (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L))
   290	        (freshDiagonalPairDist L i) := by
   291	  classical
   292	  have hequiv := uniformDistribution_map_equiv (ldSpaceBlockEquiv L)
   293	  have hprod : 0 < ∑ w ∈ (uniformDistribution ((Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) ×
   294	          (ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L)))).support.filter
   295	        (fun w => ldSeedDirEvent L i w.2),
   296	      (uniformDistribution ((Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) ×
   297	        (ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L)))).weight w := by
   298	    rw [uniformDistribution_snd_event_mass]
   299	    exact ldSeedDirEvent_positive L i
   300	  have hposA : 0 < ∑ w ∈ ((uniformDistribution (LdSpace L)).map
   301	        (ldSpaceBlockEquiv L)).support.filter
   302	        (fun w => ldSeedDirEvent L i w.2),
   303	      ((uniformDistribution (LdSpace L)).map
   304	        (ldSpaceBlockEquiv L)).weight w := by
   305	    rw [hequiv]
   306	    exact hprod
   307	  rw [← Distribution.restrict_map (uniformDistribution (LdSpace L))
   308	      (ldSpaceBlockEquiv L) (fun w => ldSeedDirEvent L i w.2)
   309	      (ldSeedEvent L i) (fun _ => Iff.rfl) hposA (ldSeedEvent_positive L i),
   310	    Distribution.restrict_congr hequiv (fun w => ldSeedDirEvent L i w.2)
   311	      hposA hprod,
   312	    restrict_uniform_prod_snd (ldSeedDirEvent L i)
   313	      (ldSeedDirEvent_positive L i) hprod]
   314	  rfl
   315	
   316	/-! ## Generating form of the restricted line-point laws -/
   317	
   318	/-- The axis-line decoder read on the block decomposition. -/
   319	def aLineDescOfBlock (L : LdParams)
   320	    (w : (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) × (ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L))) :
   321	    LineDesc L :=
   322	  aLineDescOf L ((ldSpaceBlockEquiv L).symm w)
   323	
   324	/-- The diagonal-line decoder read on the block decomposition. -/
   325	def dLineDescOfBlock (L : LdParams)
   326	    (w : (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) × (ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L)))  :
   327	    LineDesc L :=
   328	  dLineDescOf L ((ldSpaceBlockEquiv L).symm w)
   329	
   330	/-- The `i`-th restricted axis-line law is the law of the canonical
   331	axis-parallel line through a uniform point block, in the coordinate direction
   332	named by an independent fresh diagonal direction pair at index `i`, together
   333	with that same point.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
   334	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
   335	theorem restrictedALineDist_eq_map_prod (L : LdParams) (i : Fin L.m) :
   336	    restrictedALineDist L i =
   337	      (Distribution.prod (uniformDistribution (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L))
   338	          (freshDiagonalPairDist L i)).map
   339	        (fun w => (aLineDescOfBlock L w, w.1)) := by
   340	  classical
   341	  have hfun : (fun z : LdSpace L =>
   342	        (aLineDescOfBlock L (ldSpaceBlockEquiv L z),
   343	          (ldSpaceBlockEquiv L z).1)) =
   344	      fun z : LdSpace L => (aLineDescOf L z, LdSpace.point z) := by
   345	    funext z
   346	    have h : (ldSpaceBlockEquiv L).symm (ldSpaceBlockEquiv L z) = z :=
   347	      (ldSpaceBlockEquiv L).symm_apply_apply z
   348	    show (aLineDescOf L ((ldSpaceBlockEquiv L).symm (ldSpaceBlockEquiv L z)),
   349	        LdSpace.point z) = (aLineDescOf L z, LdSpace.point z)
   350	    rw [h]
   351	  rw [restrictedALineDist_eq_map_restrict,
   352	    ← restrict_uniform_ldSeedEvent_map_block, Distribution.map_map, hfun]
   353	
   354	/-- The `i`-th restricted diagonal-line law is the law of the canonical
   355	diagonal line through a uniform point block, in the prefix-projected direction
   356	of an independent fresh diagonal direction pair at index `i`, together with
   357	that same point.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
   358	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
   359	theorem restrictedDLineDist_eq_map_prod (L : LdParams) (i : Fin L.m) :
   360	    restrictedDLineDist L i =
   361	      (Distribution.prod (uniformDistribution (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L))
   362	          (freshDiagonalPairDist L i)).map
   363	        (fun w => (dLineDescOfBlock L w, w.1)) := by
   364	  classical
   365	  have hfun : (fun z : LdSpace L =>
   366	        (dLineDescOfBlock L (ldSpaceBlockEquiv L z),
   367	          (ldSpaceBlockEquiv L z).1)) =
   368	      fun z : LdSpace L => (dLineDescOf L z, LdSpace.point z) := by
   369	    funext z
   370	    have h : (ldSpaceBlockEquiv L).symm (ldSpaceBlockEquiv L z) = z :=
   371	      (ldSpaceBlockEquiv L).symm_apply_apply z
   372	    show (dLineDescOf L ((ldSpaceBlockEquiv L).symm (ldSpaceBlockEquiv L z)),
   373	        LdSpace.point z) = (dLineDescOf L z, LdSpace.point z)
   374	    rw [h]
   375	  rw [restrictedDLineDist_eq_map_restrict,
   376	    ← restrict_uniform_ldSeedEvent_map_block, Distribution.map_map, hfun]
   377	
   378	end
   379	
   380	end MIPStarRE.QPBT

1	import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.Lines.SubLineBind
     2	
     3	/-!
     4	# The two independent blocks of a fresh diagonal direction pair
     5	
     6	This module splits the fresh diagonal direction pair of the sub-line sampling
     7	procedure into its two independent blocks.  The coordinate-index event
     8	constrains only the scalar seed of the pair, so conditioning on it leaves the
     9	direction block uniform and independent of the conditioned seed.  The
    10	direction block of a fresh pair is therefore available as an unconstrained
    11	uniform vector, which is what allows the sampling procedure to read it off the
    12	corresponding block of the direction of the sampled extended line.
    13	
    14	## References
    15	
    16	The block decomposition supports `lem:qld-sublines` in
    17	blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, whose source is
    18	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`.
    19	The coordinate-index event is that of `def:ith-restricted-line`, blueprint
    20	lines 1209--1228, paper lines 1038--1048.
    21	-/
    22	
    23	open scoped BigOperators
    24	
    25	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    26	
    27	open MIPStarRE.LDT
    28	
    29	noncomputable section
    30	
    31	/-! ## Conditioning the first factor of a product -/
    32	
    33	/-- Restricting a product law to an event depending on the first factor alone
    34	leaves the second factor unchanged and independent of the conditioned first
    35	factor.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
    36	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
    37	theorem Distribution.restrict_prod_fst {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
    38	    [DecidableEq β] (μ : Distribution α) (ν : Distribution β)
    39	    (hν : ν.IsProbability) (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
    40	    (hpos : 0 < ∑ a ∈ μ.support.filter p, μ.weight a)
    41	    (hpos' : 0 < ∑ w ∈ (Distribution.prod μ ν).support.filter
    42	        (fun w => p w.1), (Distribution.prod μ ν).weight w) :
    43	    Distribution.restrict (Distribution.prod μ ν) (fun w => p w.1) hpos' =
    44	      Distribution.prod (Distribution.restrict μ p hpos) ν := by
    45	  classical
    46	  have hsupp : (Distribution.prod μ ν).support.filter (fun w => p w.1) =
    47	      (μ.support.filter p) ×ˢ ν.support := by
    48	    change (μ.support ×ˢ ν.support).filter (fun w => p w.1) =
    49	      (μ.support.filter p) ×ˢ ν.support
    50	    ext w
    51	    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product]
    52	    tauto
    53	  have hmass : (∑ w ∈ (Distribution.prod μ ν).support.filter
    54	        (fun w => p w.1), (Distribution.prod μ ν).weight w) =
    55	      ∑ a ∈ μ.support.filter p, μ.weight a := by
    56	    rw [hsupp]
    57	    have h1 : (∑ w ∈ (μ.support.filter p) ×ˢ ν.support,
    58	        (Distribution.prod μ ν).weight w) =
    59	        ∑ a ∈ μ.support.filter p, ∑ b ∈ ν.support,
    60	          μ.weight a * ν.weight b := by
    61	      rw [Finset.sum_product]
    62	      rfl
    63	    rw [h1, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ =>
    64	        (Finset.mul_sum ν.support (fun b => ν.weight b) (μ.weight a)).symm,
    65	      hν.weight_sum_eq_one]
    66	    simp
    67	  refine Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight ?_ ?_
    68	  · change (Distribution.prod μ ν).support.filter (fun w => p w.1) =
    69	      (μ.support.filter p) ×ˢ ν.support
    70	    exact hsupp
    71	  · funext w
    72	    change (if p w.1 then (Distribution.prod μ ν).weight w /
    73	        ∑ c ∈ (Distribution.prod μ ν).support.filter (fun w => p w.1),
    74	          (Distribution.prod μ ν).weight c else 0) =
    75	      (if p w.1 then μ.weight w.1 /
    76	        ∑ c ∈ μ.support.filter p, μ.weight c else 0) * ν.weight w.2
    77	    rw [hmass]
    78	    by_cases h : p w.1
    79	    · rw [if_pos h, if_pos h, div_mul_eq_mul_div]
    80	      rfl
    81	    · rw [if_neg h, if_neg h, zero_mul]
    82	
    83	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the mass of an event depending only on the
    84	first factor is the same under a uniform product law and under the uniform
    85	law of that factor.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
    86	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
    87	theorem uniformDistribution_fst_event_mass {α β : Type*} [Fintype α]
    88	    [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [Nonempty β]
    89	    (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    90	    ∑ w ∈ (uniformDistribution (α × β)).support.filter (fun w => p w.1),
    91	        (uniformDistribution (α × β)).weight w =
    92	      ∑ a ∈ (uniformDistribution α).support.filter p,
    93	        (uniformDistribution α).weight a := by
    94	  classical
    95	  rw [Distribution.sum_filter_weight_eq_avgOver,
    96	    Distribution.sum_filter_weight_eq_avgOver,
    97	    ← uniformDistribution_map_fst (α := α) (β := β), Distribution.avgOver_map]
    98	
    99	/-- Conditioning a uniform product law on an event of its first factor leaves
   100	the second factor uniform and independent.  Blueprint
   101	`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
   102	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
   103	theorem restrict_uniform_prod_fst {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   104	    [Nonempty α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [Nonempty β] (p : α → Prop)
   105	    [DecidablePred p]
   106	    (hpos : 0 < ∑ a ∈ (uniformDistribution α).support.filter p,
   107	      (uniformDistribution α).weight a)
   108	    (hpos' : 0 < ∑ w ∈ (uniformDistribution (α × β)).support.filter
   109	        (fun w => p w.1), (uniformDistribution (α × β)).weight w) :
   110	    Distribution.restrict (uniformDistribution (α × β)) (fun w => p w.1)
   111	        hpos' =
   112	      Distribution.prod
   113	        (Distribution.restrict (uniformDistribution α) p hpos)
   114	        (uniformDistribution β) := by
   115	  classical
   116	  have hpos'' : 0 < ∑ w ∈ (Distribution.prod (uniformDistribution α)
   117	        (uniformDistribution β)).support.filter (fun w => p w.1),
   118	      (Distribution.prod (uniformDistribution α)
   119	        (uniformDistribution β)).weight w := by
   120	    rw [← uniformDistribution_prod]
   121	    exact hpos'
   122	  rw [Distribution.restrict_congr (uniformDistribution_prod α β)
   123	    (fun w => p w.1) hpos' hpos'']
   124	  exact Distribution.restrict_prod_fst _ _
   125	    (uniformDistribution_isProbability β) p hpos hpos''
   126	
   127	/-! ## The coordinate-index event on a scalar seed -/
   128	
   129	/-- The coordinate-index event of `def:ith-restricted-line` read on a scalar
   130	seed alone.  Blueprint `def:ith-restricted-line`, paper
   131	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1038-1048`. -/
   132	def ldSeedIndexEvent (L : LdParams) (i : Fin L.m) (s : ScalarQ L) : Prop :=
   133	  chiIndex L s = i
   134	
   135	/-- Decidability of the coordinate-index event on a scalar seed. -/
   136	instance ldSeedIndexEvent_decidablePred (L : LdParams) (i : Fin L.m) :
   137	    DecidablePred (ldSeedIndexEvent L i) := by
   138	  intro s
   139	  unfold ldSeedIndexEvent
   140	  infer_instance
   141	
   142	/-- Every coordinate-index event of a scalar seed has positive mass under the
   143	uniform law.  Blueprint `def:ith-restricted-line`, paper
   144	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1038-1048`. -/
   145	theorem ldSeedIndexEvent_positive (L : LdParams) (i : Fin L.m) :
   146	    0 < ∑ s ∈ (uniformDistribution (ScalarQ L)).support.filter
   147	        (ldSeedIndexEvent L i),
   148	      (uniformDistribution (ScalarQ L)).weight s := by
   149	  classical
   150	  refine Finset.sum_pos'
   151	    (fun a _ => (uniformDistribution (ScalarQ L)).nonnegative a)
   152	    ⟨seedOfIndexResidue L i ⟨0, L.seedFiberCard_pos⟩,
   153	      Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨by simp, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
   154	  · change chiIndex L (seedOfIndexResidue L i ⟨0, L.seedFiberCard_pos⟩) = i
   155	    exact chiIndex_seedOfIndexResidue L i _
   156	  · simp only [uniformDistribution, Distribution.uniformOnFinset_weight,
   157	      Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
   158	    positivity
   159	
   160	/-! ## The blocks of a fresh diagonal direction pair -/
   161	
   162	/-- A fresh diagonal direction pair at coordinate index `i` is a scalar seed
   163	conditioned on the coordinate-index fiber of `i` together with an independent
   164	uniform direction block.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
   165	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
   166	theorem freshDiagonalPairDist_eq_prod (L : LdParams) (i : Fin L.m) :
   167	    freshDiagonalPairDist L i =
   168	      Distribution.prod
   169	        (Distribution.restrict (uniformDistribution (ScalarQ L))
   170	          (ldSeedIndexEvent L i) (ldSeedIndexEvent_positive L i))
   171	        (uniformDistribution (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L)) := by
   172	  classical
   173	  unfold freshDiagonalPairDist
   174	  exact restrict_uniform_prod_fst (ldSeedIndexEvent L i)
   175	    (ldSeedIndexEvent_positive L i) (ldSeedDirEvent_positive L i)
   176	
   177	/-- The direction block of a fresh diagonal direction pair is uniform.
   178	Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
   179	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
   180	theorem freshDiagonalPairDist_map_snd (L : LdParams) (i : Fin L.m) :
   181	    (freshDiagonalPairDist L i).map Prod.snd =
   182	      uniformDistribution (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) := by
   183	  classical
   184	  rw [freshDiagonalPairDist_eq_prod]
   185	  refine Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight ?_ ?_
   186	  · change (((uniformDistribution (ScalarQ L)).support.filter
   187	        (ldSeedIndexEvent L i)) ×ˢ
   188	        (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L))).image Prod.snd =
   189	      (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L))
   190	    ext v
   191	    simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, iff_true, Prod.exists]
   192	    exact ⟨seedOfIndexResidue L i ⟨0, L.seedFiberCard_pos⟩, v,
   193	      Finset.mem_product.mpr
   194	        ⟨Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨by simp, chiIndex_seedOfIndexResidue L i _⟩,
   195	          Finset.mem_univ v⟩, rfl⟩
   196	  · funext v
   197	    have hprob := Distribution.restrict_isProbability
   198	      (uniformDistribution (ScalarQ L)) (ldSeedIndexEvent L i)
   199	      (ldSeedIndexEvent_positive L i)
   200	    change (∑ w ∈ (((uniformDistribution (ScalarQ L)).support.filter
   201	        (ldSeedIndexEvent L i)) ×ˢ
   202	        (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L))).filter
   203	          (fun w => w.2 = v),
   204	        (Distribution.restrict (uniformDistribution (ScalarQ L))
   205	            (ldSeedIndexEvent L i) (ldSeedIndexEvent_positive L i)).weight w.1 *
   206	          (uniformDistribution (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L)).weight w.2) =
   207	      (uniformDistribution (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L)).weight v
   208	    have hfilter : ((((uniformDistribution (ScalarQ L)).support.filter
   209	        (ldSeedIndexEvent L i)) ×ˢ
   210	        (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L))).filter
   211	          (fun w => w.2 = v)) =
   212	        ((uniformDistribution (ScalarQ L)).support.filter
   213	          (ldSeedIndexEvent L i)) ×ˢ ({v} : Finset (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L)) := by
   214	      ext w
   215	      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_univ,
   216	        Finset.mem_singleton]
   217	      tauto
   218	    rw [hfilter, Finset.sum_product]
   219	    simp only [Finset.sum_singleton]
   220	    have hsum : (∑ s ∈ (uniformDistribution (ScalarQ L)).support.filter
   221	        (ldSeedIndexEvent L i),
   222	        (Distribution.restrict (uniformDistribution (ScalarQ L))
   223	          (ldSeedIndexEvent L i) (ldSeedIndexEvent_positive L i)).weight s)
   224	        = 1 := hprob.weight_sum_eq_one
   225	    rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hsum, one_mul]
   226	
   227	end
   228	
   229	end MIPStarRE.QPBT

1	import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.Defs
     2	
     3	/-!
     4	# Generating laws of the restricted line-point distributions
     5	
     6	This module rewrites the two restricted line-point laws of
     7	`def:ith-restricted-line` as push-forwards of a single uniformly sampled
     8	low-degree vector conditioned on the coordinate-index fiber of its retained
     9	scalar seed.  In that form the point block, the seed and the direction block
    10	of the sampled vector are visibly the independent generating data of the
    11	restricted law, which is the description used by the sampling procedure of the
    12	sub-line lemma: there the projected pairs are built either from a direction
    13	block inherited from the extended line or from freshly sampled data, and each
    14	is asserted to follow a restricted law.
    15	
    16	## References

    33	/-! ## Restriction of a push-forward -/
    34	
    35	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: restricting a push-forward distribution to a
    36	decidable event is the push-forward of the restriction to the pre-image of
    37	that event.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
    38	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
    39	theorem Distribution.restrict_map {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    40	    (μ : Distribution α) (f : α → β) (p : β → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
    41	    (q : α → Prop) [DecidablePred q] (hq : ∀ a, q a ↔ p (f a))
    42	    (hpos : 0 < ∑ b ∈ (μ.map f).support.filter p, (μ.map f).weight b)
    43	    (hpos' : 0 < ∑ a ∈ μ.support.filter q, μ.weight a) :
    44	    Distribution.restrict (μ.map f) p hpos =
    45	      (Distribution.restrict μ q hpos').map f := by
    46	  classical
    47	  have hfiber : ∀ b : β, p b →
    48	      μ.support.filter (fun a => f a = b) =
    49	        (μ.support.filter q).filter (fun a => f a = b) := by
    50	    intro b hb
    51	    ext a
    52	    simp only [Finset.mem_filter]
    53	    constructor
    54	    · rintro ⟨ha, hab⟩
    55	      exact ⟨⟨ha, (hq a).mpr (hab ▸ hb)⟩, hab⟩
    56	    · rintro ⟨⟨ha, -⟩, hab⟩
    57	      exact ⟨ha, hab⟩
    58	  have himg : (μ.map f).support.filter p = (μ.support.filter q).image f := by
    59	    ext b
    60	    simp only [Distribution.map_support, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_image]
    61	    constructor
    62	    · rintro ⟨⟨a, ha, rfl⟩, hpb⟩
    63	      exact ⟨a, ⟨ha, (hq a).mpr hpb⟩, rfl⟩
    64	    · rintro ⟨a, ⟨ha1, ha2⟩, rfl⟩
    65	      exact ⟨⟨a, ha1, rfl⟩, (hq a).mp ha2⟩
    66	  have hmass : (∑ b ∈ (μ.map f).support.filter p, (μ.map f).weight b) =
    67	      ∑ a ∈ μ.support.filter q, μ.weight a := by
    68	    rw [himg]
    69	    rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
    70	      (s := μ.support.filter q) (t := (μ.support.filter q).image f)
    71	      (g := f) (fun a ha => Finset.mem_image_of_mem f ha) μ.weight]
    72	    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b hb => ?_
    73	    obtain ⟨a0, ha0, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hb
    74	    rw [Distribution.map_weight,
    75	      hfiber _ ((hq a0).mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha0).2)]
    76	  refine Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight ?_ ?_
    77	  · exact himg
    78	  · funext b
    79	    show (if p b then (μ.map f).weight b /
    80	        ∑ c ∈ (μ.map f).support.filter p, (μ.map f).weight c else 0) =
    81	      ∑ a ∈ (μ.support.filter q).filter (fun a => f a = b),
    82	        (if q a then μ.weight a / ∑ c ∈ μ.support.filter q, μ.weight c else 0)
    83	    by_cases hb : p b
    84	    · rw [if_pos hb, hmass, Distribution.map_weight, hfiber b hb,
    85	        Finset.sum_div]
    86	      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a ha => ?_
    87	      rw [if_pos (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).1).2]
    88	    · rw [if_neg hb]
    89	      refine (Finset.sum_eq_zero fun a ha => ?_).symm
    90	      obtain ⟨ha1, ha2⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp ha
    91	      exact absurd (ha2 ▸ (hq a).mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha1).2) hb

    93	/-! ## The coordinate-index event on a single uniform vector -/
    94	
    95	/-- The coordinate-index event of `def:ith-restricted-line` read on the single
    96	uniformly sampled low-degree vector that generates the line-point laws.
    97	Blueprint `def:ith-restricted-line`, paper
    98	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1038-1048`. -/
    99	def ldSeedEvent (L : LdParams) (i : Fin L.m) (z : LdSpace L) : Prop :=
   100	  chiIndex L (LdSpace.seed z) = i
   101	
   102	/-- Decidability of the coordinate-index event. -/
   103	instance ldSeedEvent_decidablePred (L : LdParams) (i : Fin L.m) :
   104	    DecidablePred (ldSeedEvent L i) := by
   105	  intro z
   106	  unfold ldSeedEvent
   107	  infer_instance
   108	
   109	/-- The coordinate-index event has positive mass under the uniform law on
   110	low-degree vectors, so the conditioning below is normalized.  Blueprint
   111	`def:ith-restricted-line`, paper
   112	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1038-1048`. -/
   113	theorem ldSeedEvent_positive (L : LdParams) (i : Fin L.m) :
   114	    0 < ∑ z ∈ (uniformDistribution (LdSpace L)).support.filter
   115	        (ldSeedEvent L i),
   116	      (uniformDistribution (LdSpace L)).weight z := by
   117	  classical
   118	  refine Finset.sum_pos'
   119	    (fun a _ => (uniformDistribution (LdSpace L)).nonnegative a)
   120	    ⟨(fun _ => seedOfIndexResidue L i ⟨0, L.seedFiberCard_pos⟩),
   121	      Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨by simp, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
   122	  · show chiIndex L (seedOfIndexResidue L i ⟨0, L.seedFiberCard_pos⟩) = i
   123	    exact chiIndex_seedOfIndexResidue L i _
   124	  · simp only [uniformDistribution, Distribution.uniformOnFinset_weight,
   125	      Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
   126	    positivity
   127	
   128	/-! ## Canonical representatives are unchanged by the conditioning maps -/
   129	
   130	/-- Two axis-line descriptions with the same seed and the same base agree:
   131	the stored proof of `def:line-representative` invariance is a proposition and
   132	carries no further data.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
   133	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
   134	theorem lineDesc_axis_congr {L : LdParams}
   135	    {b b' : Fin L.m → ScalarQ L} {s : ScalarQ L} (h : b = b')
   136	    (hb : lineRepMap (coordinateDirection (chiIndex L s)) b = b)
   137	    (hb' : lineRepMap (coordinateDirection (chiIndex L s)) b' = b') :
   138	    LineDesc.axis b s hb = LineDesc.axis b' s hb' := by
   139	  subst h
   140	  rfl
   141	
   142	/-- Two diagonal-line descriptions with the same seed, the same base and the
   143	same direction agree: the stored proofs of `def:line-representative`
   144	invariance and of the prefix-zero condition are propositions and carry no
   145	further data.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
   146	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
   147	theorem lineDesc_diagonal_congr {L : LdParams}
   148	    {b b' d d' : Fin L.m → ScalarQ L} {s : ScalarQ L}
   149	    (hb : b = b') (hd : d = d')
   150	    (h1 : lineRepMap d b = b)
   151	    (h2 : ∀ j : Fin L.m, j.val < (chiIndex L s).val → d j = 0)
   152	    (h1' : lineRepMap d' b' = b')
   153	    (h2' : ∀ j : Fin L.m, j.val < (chiIndex L s).val → d' j = 0) :
   154	    LineDesc.diagonal b s d h1 h2 = LineDesc.diagonal b' s d' h1' h2' := by
   155	  subst hb
   156	  subst hd
   157	  rfl
   158	
   159	/-- The axis-line decoder is unchanged by the axis conditioning map: the
   160	canonical representative of `def:line-representative` is idempotent, so
   161	decoding the conditioned vector and decoding the original vector agree.
   162	Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
   163	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
   164	theorem aLineDescOf_ldALineCL (L : LdParams) (z : LdSpace L) :
   165	    aLineDescOf L (ldALineCL L z) = aLineDescOf L z :=
   166	  lineDesc_axis_congr (lineRepMap_apply_self _ _) _ _
   167	
   168	/-- The diagonal-line decoder is unchanged by the diagonal conditioning map:
   169	the prefix projection and the canonical representative of
   170	`def:line-representative` are both idempotent.  Blueprint
   171	`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
   172	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
   173	theorem dLineDescOf_ldDLineCL (L : LdParams) (z : LdSpace L) :
   174	    dLineDescOf L (ldDLineCL L z) = dLineDescOf L z := by
   175	  have hdir : prefixProjection (chiIndex L (LdSpace.seed (ldDLineCL L z)))
   176	        (LdSpace.direction (ldDLineCL L z))
   177	      = prefixProjection (chiIndex L (LdSpace.seed z)) (LdSpace.direction z) :=
   178	    prefixProjection_idempotent _ _
   179	  have hpt : lineRepMap
   180	        (prefixProjection (chiIndex L (LdSpace.seed (ldDLineCL L z)))
   181	          (LdSpace.direction (ldDLineCL L z)))
   182	        (LdSpace.point (ldDLineCL L z))
   183	      = lineRepMap
   184	        (prefixProjection (chiIndex L (LdSpace.seed z)) (LdSpace.direction z))
   185	        (LdSpace.point z) := by
   186	    rw [hdir]
   187	    exact lineRepMap_apply_self _ _
   188	  exact lineDesc_diagonal_congr hpt hdir _ _ _ _
   189	
   190	/-! ## Generating laws of the restricted line-point distributions -/
   191	
   192	/-- The `i`-th restricted axis-line law is the law of the pair consisting of
   193	the canonical axis-parallel line through a low-degree vector and its point
   194	block, when that vector is uniform conditioned on the coordinate-index fiber
   195	of its seed.  This is the generating description used in the sampling
   196	procedure of blueprint
   197	`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
   198	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
   199	theorem restrictedALineDist_eq_map_restrict (L : LdParams) (i : Fin L.m) :
   200	    restrictedALineDist L i =
   201	      (Distribution.restrict (uniformDistribution (LdSpace L))
   202	          (ldSeedEvent L i) (ldSeedEvent_positive L i)).map
   203	        (fun z => (aLineDescOf L z, LdSpace.point z)) := by
   204	  classical
   205	  have hcomp :
   206	      (fun z : LdSpace L =>
   207	          (aLineDescOf L (ldALineCL L z), LdSpace.point (ldPointCL L z))) =
   208	        fun z : LdSpace L => (aLineDescOf L z, LdSpace.point z) := by
   209	    funext z
   210	    rw [aLineDescOf_ldALineCL]
   211	    rfl
   212	  unfold restrictedALineDist restrictedALinePreDist clDistribution
   213	  rw [Distribution.restrict_map (uniformDistribution (LdSpace L))
   214	      (fun z => (ldALineCL L z, ldPointCL L z))
   215	      (restrictedLineSeedEvent L i) (ldSeedEvent L i) (fun _ => Iff.rfl)
   216	      _ (ldSeedEvent_positive L i),
   217	    Distribution.map_map]
   218	  exact congrArg _ hcomp
   219	
   220	/-- The `i`-th restricted diagonal-line law is the law of the pair consisting
   221	of the canonical diagonal line through a low-degree vector and its point
   222	block, when that vector is uniform conditioned on the coordinate-index fiber
   223	of its seed.  This is the generating description used in the sampling
   224	procedure of blueprint
   225	`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
   226	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
   227	theorem restrictedDLineDist_eq_map_restrict (L : LdParams) (i : Fin L.m) :
   228	    restrictedDLineDist L i =
   229	      (Distribution.restrict (uniformDistribution (LdSpace L))
   230	          (ldSeedEvent L i) (ldSeedEvent_positive L i)).map
   231	        (fun z => (dLineDescOf L z, LdSpace.point z)) := by
   232	  classical
   233	  have hcomp :
   234	      (fun z : LdSpace L =>
   235	          (dLineDescOf L (ldDLineCL L z), LdSpace.point (ldPointCL L z))) =
   236	        fun z : LdSpace L => (dLineDescOf L z, LdSpace.point z) := by
   237	    funext z
   238	    rw [dLineDescOf_ldDLineCL]
   239	    rfl
   240	  unfold restrictedDLineDist restrictedDLinePreDist clDistribution
   241	  rw [Distribution.restrict_map (uniformDistribution (LdSpace L))
   242	      (fun z => (ldDLineCL L z, ldPointCL L z))
   243	      (restrictedLineSeedEvent L i) (ldSeedEvent L i) (fun _ => Iff.rfl)
   244	      _ (ldSeedEvent_positive L i),
   245	    Distribution.map_map]
   246	  exact congrArg _ hcomp
   247

     5	/-!
     6	# The sampling procedure of the sub-line lemma
     7	
     8	This module carries out the sampling procedure of `lem:qld-sublines`.  A line
     9	kind is drawn from the two kinds, an extended coordinate and an extended point
    10	and direction are drawn uniformly, and two scalar seeds are drawn
    11	independently in the coordinate-index fibers of the two coordinates that the
    12	two source lines must carry.  The sampled triple consists of the axis or
    13	diagonal line of the extended sample together with the two source lines
    14	decoded from the two coordinate blocks of the extended point and direction and
    15	from the two seeds.
    16	
    17	The module records the elementary evaluations of that triple, the description
    18	of the support of the resulting law, the three pointwise properties of a
    19	sampled triple -- incidence of the two source blocks, compatibility of the
    20	affine data, and closure of the axis branch -- and the identification of its
    21	extended-line marginal.
    22	
    23	## References
    24	
    25	The construction is the proof of `lem:qld-sublines` in
    26	blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, whose source is
    27	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`.
    28	The restricted laws are `def:ith-restricted-line`, blueprint lines
    29	1209--1228, paper lines 1038--1048.
    30	-/

    32	open scoped BigOperators
    33	
    34	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    35	
    36	open MIPStarRE.LDT

    38	noncomputable section
    39	
    40	/-! ## The auxiliary randomness of one branch -/
    41	
    42	/-- An extended point together with an extended direction.  Blueprint
    43	`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
    44	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
    45	abbrev SubLinePointDir (P : AdmissibleParams) :=
    46	  (Fin P.extendedDirectLd.m → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd) ×
    47	    (Fin P.extendedDirectLd.m → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd)
    48	
    49	/-- The auxiliary randomness of one branch of the sampling procedure: an
    50	extended point, an extended direction, and the two scalar seeds of the two
    51	source lines.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
    52	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
    53	abbrev SubLineRaw (P : AdmissibleParams) :=
    54	  SubLinePointDir P × (ScalarQ P.toLdParams × ScalarQ P.toLdParams)
    55	
    56	/-- The law of the scalar seed carried by a source line at a given coordinate
    57	index: uniform on the coordinate-index fiber of that index.  Blueprint
    58	`def:ith-restricted-line`, paper
    59	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1038-1048`. -/
    60	noncomputable def subLineSeedDist (P : AdmissibleParams) (i : Fin P.m) :
    61	    Distribution (ScalarQ P.toLdParams) :=
    62	  Distribution.restrict (uniformDistribution (ScalarQ P.toLdParams))
    63	    (ldSeedIndexEvent P.toLdParams i) (ldSeedIndexEvent_positive P.toLdParams i)
    64	
    65	/-- Every seed law of a source line has total mass one. -/
    66	theorem subLineSeedDist_isProbability (P : AdmissibleParams) (i : Fin P.m) :
    67	    (subLineSeedDist P i).IsProbability := by
    68	  rw [subLineSeedDist]
    69	  exact Distribution.restrict_isProbability _ _
    70	    (ldSeedIndexEvent_positive P.toLdParams i)
    71	
    72	/-- The auxiliary randomness law of the sampling procedure: the extended
    73	coordinate is uniform, the extended point and direction are uniform and
    74	independent of it, and the two seeds are independent and uniform on the
    75	coordinate-index fibers of the two coordinates carried by the two source
    76	lines.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
    77	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
    78	noncomputable def subLineRawDist (P : AdmissibleParams) :
    79	    Distribution (Fin (2 * P.m + 2) × SubLineRaw P) :=
    80	  Distribution.bind (uniformDistribution (Fin (2 * P.m + 2))) fun k =>
    81	    (Distribution.prod (uniformDistribution (SubLinePointDir P))
    82	        (Distribution.prod (subLineSeedDist P (subLineXIndex P k))
    83	          (subLineSeedDist P (subLineZIndex P k)))).map fun w => (k, w)
    84	
    85	/-- The auxiliary randomness law has total mass one. -/
    86	theorem subLineRawDist_isProbability (P : AdmissibleParams) :
    87	    (subLineRawDist P).IsProbability := by
    88	  refine Distribution.bind_isProbability _ _
    89	    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) fun k _ => ?_
    90	  exact Distribution.IsProbability.map
    91	    (Distribution.prod_isProbability _ _ (uniformDistribution_isProbability _)
    92	      (Distribution.prod_isProbability _ _ (subLineSeedDist_isProbability P _)
    93	        (subLineSeedDist_isProbability P _))) _
    94	
    95	/-! ## The sampled triple -/
    96	
    97	/-- The extended line of a branch: the canonical axis or diagonal line of an
    98	extended sample.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
    99	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
   100	noncomputable def subLineExtLineOfSample (P : AdmissibleParams)
   101	    (kind : LineKind) (s : DirectLdSpace P.extendedDirectLd) :
   102	    DirectLineDesc P.extendedDirectLd :=
   103	  match kind with
   104	  | .axis => directALineDescOf P.extendedDirectLd s
   105	  | .diagonal => directDLineDescOf P.extendedDirectLd s
   106	
   107	/-- The extended line of a branch, read off the auxiliary randomness.
   108	Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
   109	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
   110	noncomputable def subLineExtLine (P : AdmissibleParams) (kind : LineKind)
   111	    (k : Fin (2 * P.m + 2)) (w : SubLineRaw P) :
   112	    DirectLineDesc P.extendedDirectLd :=
   113	  subLineExtLineOfSample P kind ⟨w.1.1, k, w.1.2⟩
   114	
   115	/-- A source line of a branch: the canonical axis or diagonal line decoded
   116	from a point block, a scalar seed and a direction block.  Blueprint
   117	`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
   118	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
   119	noncomputable def subLineSourceLine (P : AdmissibleParams) (kind : LineKind)
   120	    (b : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) (s : ScalarQ P.toLdParams)
   121	    (d : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) : LineDesc P.toLdParams :=
   122	  match kind with
   123	  | .axis => aLineDescOfBlock P.toLdParams (b, (s, d))
   124	  | .diagonal => dLineDescOfBlock P.toLdParams (b, (s, d))
   125	
   126	/-- The triple sampled by one branch of the procedure: the extended line
   127	together with the two source lines decoded from its two coordinate blocks and
   128	from the two scalar seeds.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`,
   129	paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`.
   130	-/
   131	noncomputable def subLineTripleOf (P : AdmissibleParams) (kind : LineKind)
   132	    (k : Fin (2 * P.m + 2)) (w : SubLineRaw P) : SubLineTriple P :=
   133	  (subLineExtLine P kind k w,
   134	    (subLineSourceLine P kind (projX (directPointToPauli P w.1.1)) w.2.1
   135	        (projX (directPointToPauli P w.1.2)),
   136	      subLineSourceLine P kind (projZ (directPointToPauli P w.1.1)) w.2.2
   137	        (projZ (directPointToPauli P w.1.2))))
   138	
   139	/-- The law of the triples sampled by one branch.  Blueprint
   140	`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
   141	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
   142	noncomputable def subLineBranchDist (P : AdmissibleParams) (kind : LineKind) :
   143	    Distribution (SubLineTriple P) :=
   144	  (subLineRawDist P).map fun w => subLineTripleOf P kind w.1 w.2
   145	
   146	/-- The sub-line law of `lem:qld-sublines`: the equal mixture of the two
   147	branches of the sampling procedure.  Blueprint
   148	`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
   149	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
   150	noncomputable def subLineDist (P : AdmissibleParams) :
   151	    Distribution (SubLineTriple P) :=
   152	  Distribution.bind (uniformDistribution (Fin 2))
   153	    ![subLineBranchDist P .axis, subLineBranchDist P .diagonal]
   154	
   155	/-! ## Elementary evaluations of the sampled triple -/
   156	
   157	/-- The extended line of a branch has the kind of that branch. -/
   158	theorem subLineExtLine_kind (P : AdmissibleParams) (kind : LineKind)
   159	    (k : Fin (2 * P.m + 2)) (w : SubLineRaw P) :
   160	    (subLineExtLine P kind k w).kind = kind := by
   161	  cases kind <;> rfl
   162	
   163	/-- The direction of the extended line of a branch is the branch direction. -/
   164	theorem subLineExtLine_direction (P : AdmissibleParams) (kind : LineKind)
   165	    (k : Fin (2 * P.m + 2)) (w : SubLineRaw P) :
   166	    (subLineExtLine P kind k w).direction =
   167	      subLineExtDirection P kind k w.1.2 := by
   168	  cases kind <;> rfl
   169	
   170	/-- The base of the extended line of a branch is the canonical representative
   171	of the drawn point in the branch direction. -/
   172	theorem subLineExtLine_base (P : AdmissibleParams) (kind : LineKind)
   173	    (k : Fin (2 * P.m + 2)) (w : SubLineRaw P) :
   174	    (subLineExtLine P kind k w).base =
   175	      lineRepMap (subLineExtDirection P kind k w.1.2) w.1.1 := by

   220	        subLineBranchDist P .diagonal] c).support) := hsample
   221	  obtain ⟨c, -, hc⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hbind

   223	      sample ∈ (subLineBranchDist P kind).support := by

   233	        (fun w => (k, w))).support) from hkw)

   235	  obtain ⟨-, hseeds⟩ := Finset.mem_product.mp hw
   236	  obtain ⟨hsx, hsz⟩ := Finset.mem_product.mp hseeds

   238	    (Finset.mem_filter.mp hsx).2
   239	  have hz : chiIndex P.toLdParams w.2.2 = subLineZIndex P k :=
   240	    (Finset.mem_filter.mp hsz).2
   241	  refine ⟨kind, k, w, hx, hz, ?_⟩
   242	  rw [← hkw', ← hw']

   462	private def subLineSampleEquiv (P : AdmissibleParams) :
   463	    DirectLdSpace P.extendedDirectLd ≃
   464	      Fin (2 * P.m + 2) × SubLinePointDir P where
   465	  toFun s := (s.index, s.point, s.direction)

   470	/-- The extended-line marginal of one branch of the sub-line law is the law of
   471	the canonical line of the corresponding kind through a uniformly sampled
   472	extended direct sample.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
   473	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
   474	theorem subLineBranchDist_map_fst (P : AdmissibleParams) (kind : LineKind) :
   475	    (subLineBranchDist P kind).map Prod.fst =
   476	      (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace P.extendedDirectLd)).map
   477	        (subLineExtLineOfSample P kind) := by
   478	  classical
   479	  have hstep1 : (subLineBranchDist P kind).map Prod.fst =
   480	      Distribution.bind (uniformDistribution (Fin (2 * P.m + 2))) fun k =>
   481	        (Distribution.prod (uniformDistribution (SubLinePointDir P))
   482	            (Distribution.prod (subLineSeedDist P (subLineXIndex P k))
   483	              (subLineSeedDist P (subLineZIndex P k)))).map
   484	          fun w => subLineExtLineOfSample P kind ⟨w.1.1, k, w.1.2⟩ := by
   485	    rw [subLineBranchDist, Distribution.map_map, subLineRawDist,
   486	      Distribution.bind_map]
   487	    refine Distribution.bind_congr_support _ _ _ fun k _ => ?_
   488	    rw [Distribution.map_map]
   489	    rfl
   490	  have hstep2 : ∀ k : Fin (2 * P.m + 2),
   491	      (Distribution.prod (uniformDistribution (SubLinePointDir P))
   492	          (Distribution.prod (subLineSeedDist P (subLineXIndex P k))
   493	            (subLineSeedDist P (subLineZIndex P k)))).map
   494	        (fun w => subLineExtLineOfSample P kind ⟨w.1.1, k, w.1.2⟩) =
   495	      (uniformDistribution (SubLinePointDir P)).map
   496	        (fun pd => subLineExtLineOfSample P kind ⟨pd.1, k, pd.2⟩) := by
   497	    intro k
   498	    exact Distribution.prod_map_of_fst
   499	      (uniformDistribution (SubLinePointDir P))
   500	      (Distribution.prod (subLineSeedDist P (subLineXIndex P k))
   501	        (subLineSeedDist P (subLineZIndex P k)))
   502	      (Distribution.prod_isProbability
   503	        (subLineSeedDist P (subLineXIndex P k))
   504	        (subLineSeedDist P (subLineZIndex P k))
   505	        (subLineSeedDist_isProbability P (subLineXIndex P k))
   506	        (subLineSeedDist_isProbability P (subLineZIndex P k)))
   507	      (fun pd => subLineExtLineOfSample P kind ⟨pd.1, k, pd.2⟩)
   508	  have hstep3 :
   509	      Distribution.bind (uniformDistribution (Fin (2 * P.m + 2))) (fun k =>
   510	        (uniformDistribution (SubLinePointDir P)).map
   511	          (fun pd => subLineExtLineOfSample P kind ⟨pd.1, k, pd.2⟩)) =
   512	      (uniformDistribution (Fin (2 * P.m + 2) × SubLinePointDir P)).map
   513	        (fun w => subLineExtLineOfSample P kind ⟨w.2.1, w.1, w.2.2⟩) := by
   514	    rw [uniformDistribution_prod (Fin (2 * P.m + 2)) (SubLinePointDir P)]
   515	    exact (Distribution.prod_map_eq_bind
   516	      (uniformDistribution (Fin (2 * P.m + 2)))
   517	      (uniformDistribution (SubLinePointDir P))
   518	      (fun w => subLineExtLineOfSample P kind ⟨w.2.1, w.1, w.2.2⟩)).symm
   519	  have hstep4 :
   520	      (uniformDistribution (Fin (2 * P.m + 2) × SubLinePointDir P)).map
   521	        (fun w => subLineExtLineOfSample P kind ⟨w.2.1, w.1, w.2.2⟩) =
   522	      (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace P.extendedDirectLd)).map
   523	        (subLineExtLineOfSample P kind) := by
   524	    rw [← uniformDistribution_map_equiv (subLineSampleEquiv P),
   525	      Distribution.map_map]
   526	    rfl
   527	  rw [hstep1, Distribution.bind_congr_support _ _ _ (fun k _ => hstep2 k),
   528	    hstep3, hstep4]
